lines.speaker: Diabolos
lines.text: Who dares approach?
lines.spoken: Who dares approach?

lines.speaker: Diabolos
lines.text: Leave this place. My power is for me, and me alone.
lines.spoken: Leave this place. My power is for me, and me alone.

lines.speaker: Volto Oscuro
lines.text: Diabolos...you pathetic weakling.
lines.spoken: Diabolos...you pathetic weakling.

lines.speaker: Diabolos
lines.text: What is the meaning--!
lines.spoken: What is the meaning--!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: M-Master...
lines.spoken: M-Master...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It is. Seeing you well does my heart good.
lines.spoken: It is. Seeing you well does my heart good.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Be not concerned for my health. I have made a bit of a recovery.
lines.spoken: Be not concerned for my health. I have made a bit of a recovery.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I have been practicing the lessons you have shown me...or rather will have shown me in the future.
lines.spoken: I have been practicing the lessons you have shown me...or rather will have shown me in the future.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But be not concerned for my health. I have made a bit of a recovery.
lines.spoken: But be not concerned for my health. I have made a bit of a recovery.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Once again, your compassion knows no bounds.
lines.spoken: Once again, your compassion knows no bounds.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I have made a bit of recovery and feel ready to move mountains.
lines.spoken: I have made a bit of recovery and feel ready to move mountains.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...I must let you know that I chanced upon Siren once more.
lines.spoken: ...I must let you know that I chanced upon Siren once more.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: She told me something that perhaps you already know: "Your presence here brings naught but chaos to this world."
lines.spoken: She told me something that perhaps you already know: "Your presence here brings naught but chaos to this world."

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: She also curiously explained that this was the case for herself as well.
lines.spoken: She also curiously explained that this was the case for herself as well.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But her situation is a trifle different, for her incarnation already exists in this time.
lines.spoken: But her situation is a trifle different, for her incarnation already exists in this time.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: If the two were to join, a small semblance of order would return, perhaps causing one of the rifts to close.
lines.spoken: If the two were to join, a small semblance of order would return, perhaps causing one of the rifts to close.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...And compared to that, my existence is an affront to all nature.
lines.spoken: ...And compared to that, my existence is an affront to all nature.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Ooof... I did not mean to trouble you so.
lines.spoken: [[uːf]]... I did not mean to trouble you so.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, your orb has been blessed with even more power than before, has it not?
lines.spoken: Master, your orb has been blessed with even more power than before, has it not?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: What a comforting glow...
lines.spoken: What a comforting glow...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I have heard of such a phenomenon, but to witness it up close... I am deeply moved by all you have accomplished to get this far.
lines.spoken: I have heard of such a phenomenon, but to witness it up close... I am deeply moved by all you have accomplished to get this far.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Many and more have supported you in your adventures throughout Vana'diel.
lines.spoken: Many and more have supported you in your adventures throughout [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: This time, I can sense the presence of another who featured prominently in tales of your adventures: Lilisette.
lines.spoken: This time, I can sense the presence of another who featured prominently in tales of your adventures: [[lˌɪlɪsˈɛt]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: And you have been assaulted by the ambassador once more!
lines.spoken: And you have been assaulted by the ambassador once more!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You bested him?
lines.spoken: You bested him?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, your strength is boundless!
lines.spoken: Master, your strength is boundless!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But...he got away, and we are no closer to the truth than we were before?
lines.spoken: But...he got away, and we are no closer to the truth than we were before?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: And there were others following in his stead!?
lines.spoken: And there were others following in his stead!?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Please, share with me the story from the very beginning, and spare no detail.
lines.spoken: Please, share with me the story from the very beginning, and spare no detail.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: He was wielding Excalibur? But...how?
lines.spoken: He was wielding Excalibur? But...how?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But only one of those exists in this world! How could he possibly... Unless...
lines.spoken: But only one of those exists in this world! How could he possibly... Unless...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Why would he single you out for assault?
lines.spoken: Why would he single you out for assault?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, I require further training at once! Will you show me all I need to know?
lines.spoken: Master, I require further training at once! Will you show me all I need to know?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Of course. I understand your hesitation.
lines.spoken: Of course. I understand your hesitation.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I shall wait for you to come to a decision.
lines.spoken: I shall wait for you to come to a decision.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, have you settled on which type of training I am to undergo?
lines.spoken: Master, have you settled on which type of training I am to undergo?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I confess that I am lacking definition in my arms and legs.
lines.spoken: I confess that I am lacking definition in my arms and legs.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I quite understand why you desire me to put on some healthy weight, and shall respect your decision.
lines.spoken: I quite understand why you desire me to put on some healthy weight, and shall respect your decision.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: And you would like to bring me a small gift to boost my spirits? Your generous soul sparkles throughout the ages.
lines.spoken: And you would like to bring me a small gift to boost my spirits? Your generous soul sparkles throughout the ages.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Ah, my fragile constitution has long dogged me.
lines.spoken: Ah, my fragile constitution has long dogged me.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I quite understand why you desire me to build up my resistance, and shall respect your decision.
lines.spoken: I quite understand why you desire me to build up my resistance, and shall respect your decision.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You wish me...to be more stylish?
lines.spoken: You wish me...to be more stylish?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I understand your desire. My mother often opined that a ninja must do all she can to blend in.
lines.spoken: I understand your desire. My mother often opined that a ninja must do all she can to blend in.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But alas, I am no ninja.
lines.spoken: But alas, I am no ninja.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Of course. Deciding on an appropriate path takes time.
lines.spoken: Of course. Deciding on an appropriate path takes time.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, this is wonderful!
lines.spoken: Master, this is wonderful!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I anxiously await learning under your steady hand and unyielding gaze!
lines.spoken: I anxiously await learning under your steady hand and unyielding gaze!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I pledge to give it my all...
lines.spoken: I pledge to give it my all...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...Using all means available to me.
lines.spoken: ...Using all means available to me.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: That was invigorating!
lines.spoken: That was invigorating!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...But it does put a strain on the stomach. Master, let us share a rice ball.
lines.spoken: ...But it does put a strain on the stomach. Master, let us share a rice ball.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: There was something on your chin.
lines.spoken: There was something on your chin.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: F-forgive me! I reverted to my old ways...before we met.
lines.spoken: F-forgive me! I reverted to my old ways...before we met.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It is a curse from my mother's upbringing. She always said that healthy eating was the key to lustrous black hair.
lines.spoken: It is a curse from my mother's upbringing. She always said that healthy eating was the key to lustrous black hair.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: And when we first met, you complimented how well it matched my features.
lines.spoken: And when we first met, you complimented how well it matched my features.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Of course, that is not something I could hope for you to remember.
lines.spoken: Of course, that is not something I could hope for you to remember.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But I was young then, and each day seemed a year long...yet your praise has stuck with me ever since.
lines.spoken: But I was young then, and each day seemed a year long...yet your praise has stuck with me ever since.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Thanks to your kind words, I have taken care of it as my pride and joy.
lines.spoken: Thanks to your kind words, I have taken care of it as my pride and joy.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Even in this time, you already know how to make me blush.
lines.spoken: Even in this time, you already know how to make me blush.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I do. It is a critical part of my identity.
lines.spoken: I do. It is a critical part of my identity.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You've already met her...but I'll leave that as a secret for now.
lines.spoken: You've already met her...but I'll leave that as a secret for now.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: This reminds me...
lines.spoken: This reminds me...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The ambassador told you he wishes to change the future, did he not?
lines.spoken: The ambassador told you he wishes to change the future, did he not?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Why would he need to muster the forces of darkness to do so?
lines.spoken: Why would he need to muster the forces of darkness to do so?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I cannot make heads or tails of it.
lines.spoken: I cannot make heads or tails of it.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: In other words, he wants to make the future much like my own.
lines.spoken: In other words, he wants to make the future much like my own.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But then how would "change" come into play?
lines.spoken: But then how would "change" come into play?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Perhaps you find this to be odd, but such a fate might be preferable to the world I know.
lines.spoken: Perhaps you find this to be odd, but such a fate might be preferable to the world I know.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Yet my head still spins at the thought of what that could mean.
lines.spoken: Yet my head still spins at the thought of what that could mean.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Father, if only I could share this pain...
lines.spoken: Father, if only I could share this pain...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Ah, but that does seem to ring true.
lines.spoken: Ah, but that does seem to ring true.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Your words have guided me out of my confusion.
lines.spoken: Your words have guided me out of my confusion.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But then how do we explain Excalibur...
lines.spoken: But then how do we explain Excalibur...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Neither do I.
lines.spoken: Neither do I.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, the time has come for you to clash with the ambassador.
lines.spoken: Master, the time has come for you to clash with the ambassador.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: As you are eminently aware, I am able to return to this world owing to the blessing of Phoenix, and that power alone.
lines.spoken: As you are eminently aware, I am able to return to this world owing to the blessing of Phoenix, and that power alone.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Yet such an act is wholly forbidden.
lines.spoken: Yet such an act is wholly forbidden.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: And there are limits to even that which as grand a power as Phoenix can achieve.
lines.spoken: And there are limits to even that which as grand a power as Phoenix can achieve.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Phoenix grows ever weaker each time I am brought back to life.
lines.spoken: Phoenix grows ever weaker each time I am brought back to life.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It is selfish of me to use it endlessly, for in reality it is something you are supposed to rely on when faced with oblivion.
lines.spoken: It is selfish of me to use it endlessly, for in reality it is something you are supposed to rely on when faced with oblivion.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You...are concerned with how I feel after being revived countless times?
lines.spoken: You...are concerned with how I feel after being revived countless times?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Any pain I may feel is a tiny prick compared to what I have suffered in my future.
lines.spoken: Any pain I may feel is a tiny prick compared to what I have suffered in my future.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: When I think back to how alone I was before coming here...my heart feels like it will burst.
lines.spoken: When I think back to how alone I was before coming here...my heart feels like it will burst.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: And deep inside...I am one weak person adrift upon the sea.
lines.spoken: And deep inside...I am one weak person adrift upon the sea.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Further, I arrived in a time a bit earlier than I had intended.
lines.spoken: Further, I arrived in a time a bit earlier than I had intended.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Despite this...despite all my failings, Phoenix has seen fit to rescue me time and again.
lines.spoken: Despite this...despite all my failings, Phoenix has seen fit to rescue me time and again.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I am but a stain on all I hold dear!
lines.spoken: I am but a stain on all I hold dear!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: That's why I must be there in the final conflict against the ambassador.
lines.spoken: That's why I must be there in the final conflict against the ambassador.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: And if I should falter due to my own unpreparedness...
lines.spoken: And if I should falter due to my own unpreparedness...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...Then it shall be no one's fault but my own. I refuse to be a burden any longer.
lines.spoken: ...Then it shall be no one's fault but my own. I refuse to be a burden any longer.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You have striven so hard to fill the orb I gave you with light, and I know you will be prepared for the final struggle.
lines.spoken: You have striven so hard to fill the orb I gave you with light, and I know you will be prepared for the final struggle.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, none know that better than I.
lines.spoken: Master, none know that better than I.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You've touched many during your adventures throughout the land--and not just those who have lent power to your orb.
lines.spoken: You've touched many during your adventures throughout the land--and not just those who have lent power to your orb.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Even I understand that anything can be accomplished with the support of those close to you.
lines.spoken: Even I understand that anything can be accomplished with the support of those close to you.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, do not make light of my steadfast determination to protect all I hold dear.
lines.spoken: Master, do not make light of my steadfast determination to protect all I hold dear.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The Goddess Altana?
lines.spoken: The Goddess [[ɔːltˈɑːnə]]?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I had not expected such a...divine proposal.
lines.spoken: I had not expected such a...divine proposal.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You do not have to display such concern for me. After all, my presence here only serves as an affront to nature.
lines.spoken: You do not have to display such concern for me. After all, my presence here only serves as an affront to nature.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Yet there is a certain logic... Perhaps She would be able to provide us with the guidance we so desperately seek.
lines.spoken: Yet there is a certain logic... Perhaps She would be able to provide us with the guidance we so desperately seek.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: If any would know how to meet with Altana, it would be the ancients.
lines.spoken: If any would know how to meet with [[ɔːltˈɑːnə]], it would be the ancients.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You have a most queer look on your face, Master.
lines.spoken: You have a most queer look on your face, Master.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: On several occasions you told me about your encounters with them.
lines.spoken: On several occasions you told me about your encounters with them.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Or perhaps "will tell me" would be a better phrase.
lines.spoken: Or perhaps "will tell me" would be a better phrase.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Stories about Kam'lanaut and Eald'narche.
lines.spoken: Stories about Kam'lanaut and Eald'narche.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Those who ruled over Jeuno were a different race than any of us.
lines.spoken: Those who ruled over [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]] were a different race than any of us.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Their status as the grand ancestors of this world may provide us with clues.
lines.spoken: Their status as the grand ancestors of this world may provide us with clues.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Ah, but I know.
lines.spoken: Ah, but I know.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Those two have passed on. No, I speak of asking advice of the Kuluu.
lines.spoken: Those two have passed on. No, I speak of asking advice of the [[kjˈʊluː]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But we cannot simply drop in without making the proper preparations. We should seek advice from our allies in Norg.
lines.spoken: But we cannot simply drop in without making the proper preparations. We should seek advice from our allies in [[nɔːɹɡ]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It would be folly, however, to believe that they would volunteer such information for only a kind word.
lines.spoken: It would be folly, however, to believe that they would volunteer such information for only a kind word.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: No, we should first seek advice from Gilgamesh in Norg.
lines.spoken: No, we should first seek advice from [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]] in [[nɔːɹɡ]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I would instead recommend that we seek out the Kuluu.
lines.spoken: I would instead recommend that we seek out the [[kjˈʊluː]].

lines.speaker: Nashmeira
lines.text: Thank goodness you've arrived.
lines.spoken: Thank goodness you've arrived.

lines.speaker: Nashmeira
lines.text: This building--and those like it scattered throughout the land--are historic ruins of the great Alzadaal Dynasty, which flourished over 900 years ago.
lines.spoken: This building--and those like it scattered throughout the land--are historic ruins of the great [[ˈɐlzɜːdˌɑːl]] Dynasty, which flourished over 900 years ago.

lines.speaker: Nashmeira
lines.text: Only under the most special of circumstances are those not from our lands permitted entry.
lines.spoken: Only under the most special of circumstances are those not from our lands permitted entry.

lines.speaker: Nashmeira
lines.text: I'm afraid I cannot explain more at present, but this edifice is related to the prime avatar spoken of in Aht Urhganian legends.
lines.spoken: I'm afraid I cannot explain more at present, but this edifice is related to the prime avatar spoken of in Aht Urhganian legends.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: <player> and I would surely like to hear more about what exactly this prime avatar is.
lines.spoken: adventurer and I would surely like to hear more about what exactly this prime avatar is.

lines.speaker: Nashmeira
lines.text: In simple terms...an iron giant.
lines.spoken: In simple terms...an iron giant.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: An iron giant!?
lines.spoken: An iron giant!?

lines.speaker: Nashmeira
lines.text: Its name is Alexander--a being that commands the forces light.
lines.spoken: Its name is Alexander--a being that commands the forces light.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Huh?
lines.spoken: Huh?

lines.speaker: Nashmeira
lines.text: How is--
lines.spoken: How is--

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: What on Vana'diel...
lines.spoken: What on [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]]...

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: Ah, Phoenix. Thy voice always grated on mine ears.
lines.spoken: Ah, Phoenix. Thy voice always grated on mine ears.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: Oho. But 'twould seem thou art even more cacophonous than usual. Perhaps because now there are two of thee.
lines.spoken: Oho. But 'twould seem thou art even more cacophonous than usual. Perhaps because now there are two of thee.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: Ah, so one carrying thy blessing has alighted on this land from the future.
lines.spoken: Ah, so one carrying thy blessing has alighted on this land from the future.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: I understand thy predicament.
lines.spoken: I understand thy predicament.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: If thou dost deem her to be of great importance, then I shall honor thy request to give her form in this world once more.
lines.spoken: If thou dost deem her to be of great importance, then I shall honor thy request to give her form in this world once more.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Iroha!
lines.spoken: Lady [[ɪɹˈohə]]!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master... Sir Tenzen...
lines.spoken: Master... Sir [[tˈɛnzən]]...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Iroha, your journey to the realm of the living has surely taken its toll. Permit me to explain in your stead.
lines.spoken: Lady [[ɪɹˈohə]], your journey to the realm of the living has surely taken its toll. Permit me to explain in your stead.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: None understand better than I.
lines.spoken: None understand better than I.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Phoenix has become whole in the future, and its life force has brought Iroha back to us.
lines.spoken: Phoenix has become whole in the future, and its life force has brought [[ɪɹˈohə]] back to us.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Yet this is not the first time, and gods strike me if it is the last.
lines.spoken: Yet this is not the first time, and gods strike me if it is the last.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: She is stuck within the cycle of life, returning to Vana'diel each time she is struck down.
lines.spoken: She is stuck within the cycle of life, returning to [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]] each time she is struck down.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Would that I were not endlessly reliant on my family to rescue me after each mishap...
lines.spoken: Would that I were not endlessly reliant on my family to rescue me after each mishap...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: My blade once held power of a similar magnitude, so I am all too familiar with the particulars.
lines.spoken: My blade once held power of a similar magnitude, so I am all too familiar with the particulars.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Yet just as flame can cauterize a grievous wound, so too are Phoenix's blazing wings of life accompanied by indelible pain. Am I wrong?
lines.spoken: Yet just as flame can cauterize a grievous wound, so too are [[fˈiːnɪksᵻz]] blazing wings of life accompanied by indelible pain. Am I wrong?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: There is no need to put on a brave front. Though your body may have recovered, your spirit yet needs time to heal.
lines.spoken: There is no need to put on a brave front. Though your body may have recovered, your spirit yet needs time to heal.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: There is naught else for me to do...
lines.spoken: There is naught else for me to do...

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: That girl's presence in this world is forbidden, and is why death doth clamor to claim her at every opportunity.
lines.spoken: That girl's presence in this world is forbidden, and is why death doth clamor to claim her at every opportunity.

lines.speaker: Nashmeira
lines.text: Forbidden...?
lines.spoken: Forbidden...?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Doubtless because she has not yet been born.
lines.spoken: Doubtless because she has not yet been born.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: Order must be obeyed, and all that would threaten it shall be expunged.
lines.spoken: Order must be obeyed, and all that would threaten it shall be expunged.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: Even Phoenix can only protect her for so long. Its breath draws ever fainter, its energies beginning to wane.
lines.spoken: Even Phoenix can only protect her for so long. Its breath draws ever fainter, its energies beginning to wane.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: I have done what I can, but whether she is long for this world is not something for me to decide.
lines.spoken: I have done what I can, but whether she is long for this world is not something for me to decide.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I care not what hardships I must overcome. Master must bring light to my future, and my calling is to guide him along the path.
lines.spoken: I care not what hardships I must overcome. Master must bring light to my future, and my calling is to guide him along the path.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I care not what hardships I must overcome. Master must bring light to my future, and my calling is to guide her along the path.
lines.spoken: I care not what hardships I must overcome. Master must bring light to my future, and my calling is to guide her along the path.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: And thou wilt stop at naught to banish the Emptiness.
lines.spoken: And thou wilt stop at naught to banish the Emptiness.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: Yet the Emptiness bringeth absolute darkness; it is not the absence of light I shall face in the end.
lines.spoken: Yet the Emptiness bringeth absolute darkness; it is not the absence of light I shall face in the end.

lines.speaker: Alexander
lines.text: Yet the Emptiness bringeth absolute darkness; it is not the absence of light I shall face when Ragnarok cometh.
