lines.text: Don't worry--never fear. If anyone can come out unscathed, it's him.
lines.spoken: Don't worry--never fear. If anyone can come out unscathed, it's him.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: Don't worry--never fear. If anyone can come out unscathed, it's her.
lines.spoken: Don't worry--never fear. If anyone can come out unscathed, it's her.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: You foul creature! Masked madman! I'll fight you tooth and claw!
lines.spoken: You foul creature! Masked madman! I'll fight you tooth and claw!

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: <player>, I can't believe it...
lines.spoken: adventurer, I can't believe it...

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: He got away. Fled for the hills.
lines.spoken: He got away. Fled for the hills.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: He absorbed Atomos's power and skedaddled out of here before either of us could stop him!
lines.spoken: He absorbed [[ˈætomoʊzɪz]] power and skedaddled out of here before either of us could stop him!

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: After my impassioned speech, too... Oh, I can be so scatterbrained.
lines.spoken: After my impassioned speech, too... Oh, I can be so scatterbrained.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: But I made my bed, so I've got to lie in it.
lines.spoken: But I made my bed, so I've got to lie in it.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: But this masked man...this ambassador of the void...I get the sense that he's holding back.
lines.spoken: But this masked man...this ambassador of the void...I get the sense that he's holding back.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: If he was able to bring Atomos to its knees, then he could obliterate us with a snap of his fingers--but he didn't.
lines.spoken: If he was able to bring [[ˈætomoʊz]] to its knees, then he could obliterate us with a snap of his fingers--but he didn't.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: <player>, have you been declawed or something!? Lost all your gumption!?
lines.spoken: adventurer, have you been declawed or something!? Lost all your gumption!?

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: With Atomos weakened, your "bright future" is naught but dust scattered before the wind!
lines.spoken: With [[ˈætomoʊz]] weakened, your "bright future" is naught but dust scattered before the wind!

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: Then we've no hope!?
lines.spoken: Then we've no hope!?

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: Before he was completely drained, he gobbled it all up--I saw it with these two eyes!
lines.spoken: Before he was completely drained, he gobbled it all up--I saw it with these two eyes!

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: And you call yourself a savior of Vana'diel! A protector of the realm!
lines.spoken: And you call yourself a savior of [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]]! A protector of the realm!

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: Did you actually want to save the future, or did you just want to take credit for it!?
lines.spoken: Did you actually want to save the future, or did you just want to take credit for it!?

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: Hey now, come off it!
lines.spoken: Hey now, come off it!

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: Hey now, Cait Sith, come off it!
lines.spoken: Hey now, [[kˈɛt ʃˈiː]], come off it!

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: For someone complaining so loudly, your hands are quite warm from hiding them under your posterior!
lines.spoken: For someone complaining so loudly, your hands are quite warm from hiding them under your posterior!

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: Meooow!
lines.spoken: Meooow!

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: But it stings to admit that there's a kernel of truth in that. What do we do now?
lines.spoken: But it stings to admit that there's a kernel of truth in that. What do we do now?

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: There's still the idea of meeting Altana, but how does one go about finding a goddess?
lines.spoken: There's still the idea of meeting [[ɔːltˈɑːnə]], but how does one go about finding a goddess?

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: Perhaps your friend Iroha can provide us with answers.
lines.spoken: Perhaps your friend [[ɪɹˈohə]] can provide us with answers.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: After all, she's the one who bid you to absorb light into your orb.
lines.spoken: After all, she's the one who bid you to absorb light into your orb.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: If she thinks that there's still some light left to gather, then the future may not be as doom-and-gloom as Cait Sith thinks.
lines.spoken: If she thinks that there's still some light left to gather, then the future may not be as doom-and-gloom as [[kˈɛt ʃˈiː]] thinks.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: Hmph.
lines.spoken: [[hʊmf]].

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: You think I'm full of bluster and bravado? Then let me show you what I'm made of. Demonstrate all that I can do.
lines.spoken: You think I'm full of bluster and bravado? Then let me show you what I'm made of. Demonstrate all that I can do.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: You'd do that for us?
lines.spoken: You'd do that for us?

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: My whiskers can tell your fortune better than any old bones.
lines.spoken: My whiskers can tell your fortune better than any old bones.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: And right now, they're telling me that your best chance to meet Iroha is to head back to Norg.
lines.spoken: And right now, they're telling me that your best chance to meet [[ɪɹˈohə]] is to head back to [[nɔːɹɡ]].

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: And you got all that from your whiskers? If that's what you say, then I'll choose to believe you, I suppose.
lines.spoken: And you got all that from your whiskers? If that's what you say, then I'll choose to believe you, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: The best course of action is for us to split up.
lines.spoken: The best course of action is for us to split up.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: I've been charged with protecting Lilith's world, so I can't stay here for long.
lines.spoken: I've been charged with protecting Lilith's world, so I can't stay here for long.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: I've got responsibilities to finding out about Lilith's future. I'm sorry that I've got to prioritize that.
lines.spoken: I've got responsibilities to finding out about Lilith's future. I'm sorry that I've got to prioritize that.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: I've got responsibilities to finding out about the past. I'm sorry that I've got to prioritize that.
lines.spoken: I've got responsibilities to finding out about the past. I'm sorry that I've got to prioritize that.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: But just like that orb, I'll always be there by your side.
lines.spoken: But just like that orb, I'll always be there by your side.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: Never forget that.
lines.spoken: Never forget that.

lines.speaker: Lilisette
lines.text: Be safe, <player>!
lines.spoken: Be safe, adventurer!

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: Oh, no...I forgot to tell them...
lines.spoken: Oh, no...I forgot to tell them...

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: For someone who came from the future, his form here was quite solid. Wholly unyielding.
lines.spoken: For someone who came from the future, his form here was quite solid. Wholly unyielding.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: I have a feeling that he--and his other masked companions--exist in this timeline as well.
lines.spoken: I have a feeling that he--and his other masked companions--exist in this timeline as well.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: And then there's something else I saw for a brief moment. Laid my eyes on for a fleeting instant.
lines.spoken: And then there's something else I saw for a brief moment. Laid my eyes on for a fleeting instant.

lines.speaker: Cait Sith
lines.text: The eyes never lie, but...it can't be...
lines.spoken: The eyes never lie, but...it can't be...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master...
lines.spoken: Master...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It is nothing. I needed a few days of respite.
lines.spoken: It is nothing. I needed a few days of respite.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I pray it was the orb that led you here? For a brief moment I feared that we would not meet again in this world.
lines.spoken: I pray it was the orb that led you here? For a brief moment I feared that we would not meet again in this world.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I have learned that all the energies of the mothercrystals converge upon this very tower.
lines.spoken: I have learned that all the energies of the mothercrystals converge upon this very tower.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...And that is why I have come. To see if we may be able to borrow but a fraction so that we may set things right.
lines.spoken: ...And that is why I have come. To see if we may be able to borrow but a fraction so that we may set things right.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The crystal...it murmured something to me... "The chains of Promathia."
lines.spoken: The crystal...it murmured something to me... "The chains of [[pɹoʊmˈɑːθiə]]."

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, another path was laid before you, and as you walked it you encountered one who would shape your future.
lines.spoken: Master, another path was laid before you, and as you walked it you encountered one who would shape your future.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: There is but one last step you must take to bring light unto the orb.
lines.spoken: There is but one last step you must take to bring light unto the orb.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Did it not show you a particular person when it guided you here?
lines.spoken: Did it not show you a particular person when it guided you here?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...It does not surprise me to hear that Prishe appeared before you.
lines.spoken: ...It does not surprise me to hear that [[pɹˈiːʃ]] appeared before you.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Oft would you speak to me of the adventures the two of you shared.
lines.spoken: Oft would you speak to me of the adventures the two of you shared.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The orb does naught without just cause. You must seek her out and let the winds of fate blow you where they may.
lines.spoken: The orb does naught without just cause. You must seek her out and let the winds of fate blow you where they may.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Perhaps there is another trial for you to overcome.
lines.spoken: Perhaps there is another trial for you to overcome.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I ask you, please do as the crystal bids.
lines.spoken: I ask you, please do as the crystal bids.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Behind every door you open is another meeting that could decide the fate of Vana'diel.
lines.spoken: Behind every door you open is another meeting that could decide the fate of [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The crystal has laid out a path for you to walk, and I fear it is one you must traverse without my aid.
lines.spoken: The crystal has laid out a path for you to walk, and I fear it is one you must traverse without my aid.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You must strive ever forward, finding a chance meeting that could decide the fate of Vana'diel.
lines.spoken: You must strive ever forward, finding a chance meeting that could decide the fate of [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The orb cries out for light...your journey is what will fill it with everlasting radiance.
lines.spoken: The orb cries out for light...your journey is what will fill it with everlasting radiance.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You...you wish for me to meet a man named Tenzen from the Far East?
lines.spoken: You...you wish for me to meet a man named [[tˈɛnzən]] from the Far East?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I should not be so taken aback. It is only natural for my path to cross with his in this era.
lines.spoken: I should not be so taken aback. It is only natural for my path to cross with his in this era.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Of course I am intimately familiar with...Sir Tenzen.
lines.spoken: Of course I am intimately familiar with...Sir [[tˈɛnzən]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: He was the one who strongly insisted that I train under you and learn all I can.
lines.spoken: He was the one who strongly insisted that I train under you and learn all I can.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: So it shall be.
lines.spoken: So it shall be.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But before that can happen, you must pass the trials set before you by the chains of Promathia.
lines.spoken: But before that can happen, you must pass the trials set before you by the chains of [[pɹoʊmˈɑːθiə]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Recall what happened between you and Lion. The flow of even the mightiest river can be altered with a single stone.
lines.spoken: Recall what happened between you and Lion. The flow of even the mightiest river can be altered with a single stone.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Although I had hoped to give my regards to Prishe in person first.
lines.spoken: Although I had hoped to give my regards to [[pɹˈiːʃ]] in person first.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: But perhaps you are right--meeting with Sir Tenzen is paramount.
lines.spoken: But perhaps you are right--meeting with Sir [[tˈɛnzən]] is paramount.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The appearance of new rifts in Vana'diel has surely not escaped your notice.
lines.spoken: The appearance of new rifts in [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]] has surely not escaped your notice.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I feel it prudent to examine them for myself.
lines.spoken: I feel it prudent to examine them for myself.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: While you are pursuing your destiny regarding the chains of Promathia, I will go on ahead and learn what I can about Escha.
lines.spoken: While you are pursuing your destiny regarding the chains of [[pɹoʊmˈɑːθiə]], I will go on ahead and learn what I can about Escha.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: This leaves me with just one question--where can I meet with Sir Tenzen?
lines.spoken: This leaves me with just one question--where can I meet with Sir [[tˈɛnzən]]?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It stands to reason he would visit the fabled city. Let us rendezvous in Ru'Lude Gardens and seek him out.
lines.spoken: It stands to reason he would visit the fabled city. Let us rendezvous in [[ɹˈuːluːd]] Gardens and seek him out.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: That certainly is one possibility. Then let us head for Tavnazia.
lines.spoken: That certainly is one possibility. Then let us head for [[tævnˈaːziə]].

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: Hold!
lines.spoken: Hold!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Who is--
lines.spoken: Who is--

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Is that...Kagero?
lines.spoken: Is that...[[kædʒˈɛɹoʊ]]?

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: How do you know my name?
lines.spoken: How do you know my name?

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: Sir Tenzen makes way for Ru'Lude Gardens. You, too, would do best not to delay.
lines.spoken: Sir [[tˈɛnzən]] makes way for [[ɹˈuːluːd]] Gardens. You, too, would do best not to delay.

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: I shall ensure that Sir Tenzen arrives in Jeuno safely. I bid you await him in Ru'Lude Gardens.
lines.spoken: I shall ensure that Sir [[tˈɛnzən]] arrives in [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]] safely. I bid you await him in [[ɹˈuːluːd]] Gardens.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Then the path before us is clear.
lines.spoken: Then the path before us is clear.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I find it doubtful that he would head back after having arrived only some few days before. Perhaps he is elsewhere?
lines.spoken: I find it doubtful that he would head back after having arrived only some few days before. Perhaps he is elsewhere?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: With your leave.
lines.spoken: With your leave.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lord <player>, please forgive my hasty departure earlier. I have had some time to reflect on my journey here...
lines.spoken: Lord adventurer, please forgive my hasty departure earlier. I have had some time to reflect on my journey here...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady <player>, please forgive my hasty departure earlier. I have had some time to reflect on my journey here...
lines.spoken: Lady adventurer, please forgive my hasty departure earlier. I have had some time to reflect on my journey here...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: It is about the Emptiness threatening to consume my land.
lines.spoken: It is about the Emptiness threatening to consume my land.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I surmise that it is intimately connected to this destructive force that threatens to claim the future, just as Gilgamesh was telling me in Norg.
lines.spoken: I surmise that it is intimately connected to this destructive force that threatens to claim the future, just as [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]] was telling me in [[nɔːɹɡ]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: The Emptiness will have doubtlessly spread from the Far East, its tendrils stretching ever westward.
lines.spoken: The Emptiness will have doubtlessly spread from the Far East, its tendrils stretching ever westward.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lord <player>, forgive me...would that I had been stronger...
lines.spoken: Lord adventurer, forgive me...would that I had been stronger...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady <player>, forgive me...would that I had been stronger...
lines.spoken: Lady adventurer, forgive me...would that I had been stronger...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: But you know what it means for me to be standing before you here.
lines.spoken: But you know what it means for me to be standing before you here.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lord <player>, you know what it means for me to be standing before you here.
lines.spoken: Lord adventurer, you know what it means for me to be standing before you here.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady <player>, you know what it means for me to be standing before you here.
lines.spoken: Lady adventurer, you know what it means for me to be standing before you here.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I must confess to stationing one of my agents around the area after our soiree in Norg.
lines.spoken: I must confess to stationing one of my agents around the area after our soiree in [[nɔːɹɡ]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: It was not for any nefarious purpose, I assure you--it was merely to gather what information I could about the destruction of the future.
lines.spoken: It was not for any nefarious purpose, I assure you--it was merely to gather what information I could about the destruction of the future.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: And as I implied earlier, the Emptiness is almost certainly the cause of Iroha's claims.
lines.spoken: And as I implied earlier, the Emptiness is almost certainly the cause of [[ˈɪɹoʊhəz]] claims.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lord <player>, the Emptiness ceased to encroach when Prishe and her companions toppled Promathia.
lines.spoken: Lord adventurer, the Emptiness ceased to encroach when [[pɹˈiːʃ]] and her companions toppled [[pɹoʊmˈɑːθiə]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady <player>, the Emptiness ceased to encroach when Prishe and her companions toppled Promathia.
lines.spoken: Lady adventurer, the Emptiness ceased to encroach when [[pɹˈiːʃ]] and her companions toppled [[pɹoʊmˈɑːθiə]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Something horrific must have happened for it to rear its head once more.
lines.spoken: Something horrific must have happened for it to rear its head once more.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I would ask Iroha to tell me what she knows.
lines.spoken: I would ask [[ɪɹˈohə]] to tell me what she knows.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Forgive me for keeping you waiting, Master.
lines.spoken: Forgive me for keeping you waiting, Master.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Sir Tenzen, the pleasure is mine.
lines.spoken: Sir [[tˈɛnzən]], the pleasure is mine.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I am so glad to see you again.
lines.spoken: I am so glad to see you again.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Again? But this is the first time we...
lines.spoken: Again? But this is the first time we...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ah, but of course. You mean to say that you have met me in the future.
lines.spoken: Ah, but of course. You mean to say that you have met me in the future.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You are the very reason I am able to stand here today. My tears flowed like rain when last we parted.
lines.spoken: You are the very reason I am able to stand here today. My tears flowed like rain when last we parted.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: ...You mean to say that I was swallowed up in the Emptiness.
lines.spoken: ...You mean to say that I was swallowed up in the Emptiness.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Not just you. Everyone.
lines.spoken: Not just you. Everyone.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I thought myself better prepared for this. So such a future does come to pass.
lines.spoken: I thought myself better prepared for this. So such a future does come to pass.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: The question that remains...is why?
lines.spoken: The question that remains...is why?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Has some nefarious new force arisen to force open the Gates of Paradise?
lines.spoken: Has some nefarious new force arisen to force open the Gates of Paradise?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Or is there another threatening to absorb the power of the crystals for its own vile ends?
lines.spoken: Or is there another threatening to absorb the power of the crystals for its own vile ends?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Neither you nor Master shared with me the particulars.
lines.spoken: Neither you nor Master shared with me the particulars.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Strife descended upon us in but an instant. Umbral energies radiated from the crystal, and the world was wrapped in gloom before we had a chance to draw breath.
lines.spoken: Strife descended upon us in but an instant. Umbral energies radiated from the crystal, and the world was wrapped in gloom before we had a chance to draw breath.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: You mean that we were obliterated into the darkness without knowing why?
lines.spoken: You mean that we were obliterated into the darkness without knowing why?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Or was there a reason why we could not tell you?
lines.spoken: Or was there a reason why we could not tell you?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I fear the plot will continue to thicken.
lines.spoken: I fear the plot will continue to thicken.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Then there is only one thing to do!
lines.spoken: Then there is only one thing to do!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Then that means...I failed.
lines.spoken: Then that means...I failed.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Sir Tenzen, lift your head.
lines.spoken: Sir [[tˈɛnzən]], lift your head.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: In my era, you and the master were revered as heroes of the highest caliber.
lines.spoken: In my era, you and the master were revered as heroes of the highest caliber.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It was not any failure on your behalf. When darkness poured forth from the crystal, there was nothing you could have done to stop it.
lines.spoken: It was not any failure on your behalf. When darkness poured forth from the crystal, there was nothing you could have done to stop it.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Secluded on that small island, I was unable to stem the rising tide, and the world was torn asunder...
lines.spoken: Secluded on that small island, I was unable to stem the rising tide, and the world was torn asunder...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Heavens be good...
lines.spoken: Heavens be good...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: There is only one thing we can do.
lines.spoken: There is only one thing we can do.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: We must protect our world!
lines.spoken: We must protect our world!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lord <player>, Lady Iroha.
lines.spoken: Lord adventurer, Lady [[ɪɹˈohə]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady <player>, Lady Iroha.
lines.spoken: Lady adventurer, Lady [[ɪɹˈohə]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: The future is ours for the taking, and I swear to fight until I have drawn my last breath!
lines.spoken: The future is ours for the taking, and I swear to fight until I have drawn my last breath!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Wh-what!?
lines.spoken: Wh-what!?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Does it mean to absorb the fire burning in my heart!?
lines.spoken: Does it mean to absorb the fire burning in my heart!?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: No, Sir Tenzen. Your passion has brought new life unto the orb!
lines.spoken: No, Sir [[tˈɛnzən]]. Your passion has brought new life unto the orb!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Would that it were sufficient...but the light remains ever pale.
lines.spoken: Would that it were sufficient...but the light remains ever pale.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You have yet to meet with Lady Prishe, correct?
lines.spoken: You have yet to meet with Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]], correct?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, when you recounted tales of your exploits, Lady Prishe was a prominent figure. You oft waxed lyrical about how her prowess was beyond compare.
lines.spoken: Master, when you recounted tales of your exploits, Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]] was a prominent figure. You oft waxed lyrical about how her prowess was beyond compare.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Prishe...? Who is this woman of whom you speak?
lines.spoken: [[pɹˈiːʃ]]...? Who is this woman of whom you speak?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Ah, so the two of you have yet to cross paths.
lines.spoken: Ah, so the two of you have yet to cross paths.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: This would explain why the orb is scarce as bright as a torch.
lines.spoken: This would explain why the orb is scarce as bright as a torch.

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: Lady Prishe has but recently arrived in Jeuno.
lines.spoken: Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]] has but recently arrived in [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]].

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: Permit me to seek her out and lead her to the port.
lines.spoken: Permit me to seek her out and lead her to the port.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Our next destination is clear to us.
lines.spoken: Our next destination is clear to us.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: She is, of course, here in Jeuno.
lines.spoken: She is, of course, here in [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Yet I fear for her health. We should first complete our business in Pso'Xja while she recovers.
lines.spoken: Yet I fear for her health. We should first complete our business in [[sˈoʊdʒɑː]] while she recovers.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lord <player>, forgive me my brashness, but I must insist that that should be our first course of action.
lines.spoken: Lord adventurer, forgive me my brashness, but I must insist that that should be our first course of action.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady <player>, forgive me my brashness, but I must insist that that should be our first course of action.
lines.spoken: Lady adventurer, forgive me my brashness, but I must insist that that should be our first course of action.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Let us petition for her assistance once she has rejoined us in the world of the living.
lines.spoken: Let us petition for her assistance once she has rejoined us in the world of the living.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Port Jeuno would seem as good a place as any to reunite.
lines.spoken: Port [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]] would seem as good a place as any to reunite.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Perhaps we should call her back to Jeuno.
lines.spoken: Perhaps we should call her back to [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]].

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: I would offer to bring her back here to Jeuno myself...
lines.spoken: I would offer to bring her back here to [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]] myself...

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: ...But I need not remind you that the situation is rather complicated.
lines.spoken: ...But I need not remind you that the situation is rather complicated.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Let us meet back in Port Jeuno once Prishe's hands are free.
lines.spoken: Let us meet back in Port [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]] once Prishe's hands are free.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, the fire in Sir Tenzen's heart is evident. You must meet with Prishe without delay.
lines.spoken: Master, the fire in Sir Tenzen's heart is evident. You must meet with [[pɹˈiːʃ]] without delay.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I must confess that the only reason I am standing here today to aid you...
lines.spoken: I must confess that the only reason I am standing here today to aid you...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...is that I received a benevolent puissance when you and Sir Tenzen visited me on Reisenjima during the ultimate conflict.
lines.spoken: ...is that I received a benevolent puissance when you and Sir [[tˈɛnzən]] visited me on [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] during the ultimate conflict.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Yet I must reiterate that I do not exist in this era.
lines.spoken: Yet I must reiterate that I do not exist in this era.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: My presence has caused the wheel of fate to spin, and I fear that it may not come to rest in an advantageous position.
lines.spoken: My presence has caused the wheel of fate to spin, and I fear that it may not come to rest in an advantageous position.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Yet should you remain ever unflinching as you tackle this most arduous of journeys...
lines.spoken: Yet should you remain ever unflinching as you tackle this most arduous of journeys...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Then perhaps my appearance here matters not, and you will be able to lead us to a brighter future.
lines.spoken: Then perhaps my appearance here matters not, and you will be able to lead us to a brighter future.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, I shall head to the port while you search for Lady Prishe.
lines.spoken: Master, I shall head to the port while you search for Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Please...let me rest here...until we meet Lady Prishe...
lines.spoken: Please...let me rest here...until we meet Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]]...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Coins oft loosen lips at taverns and markets, but to turn up empty-handed... Where could she have gone?
lines.spoken: Coins oft loosen lips at taverns and markets, but to turn up empty-handed... Where could she have gone?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: <player>! Is that...?
lines.spoken: adventurer! Is that...?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Stand strong!
lines.spoken: Stand strong!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Back, cur!
lines.spoken: Back, cur!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: You...you came from Iroha's future.
lines.spoken: You...you came from [[ˈɪɹoʊhəz]] future.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I know not why you seek to spread the Emptiness, but you will have to get through my blade first!
lines.spoken: I know not why you seek to spread the Emptiness, but you will have to get through my blade first!

lines.speaker: Volto Oscuro
lines.text: I cannot be destroyed.
lines.spoken: I cannot be destroyed.

lines.speaker: Volto Oscuro
lines.text: Let the darkness fill thy soul...there is no other way...
lines.spoken: Let the darkness fill thy soul...there is no other way...

lines.speaker: Volto Oscuro
lines.text: The reckoning is at hand.
lines.spoken: The reckoning is at hand.

lines.speaker: Volto Oscuro
lines.text: And you, Tenzen...will lead them there.
lines.spoken: And you, [[tˈɛnzən]]...will lead them there.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Iroha! Come back to us!
lines.spoken: [[ɪɹˈohə]]! Come back to us!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: The ambassador shall not go unpunished!
lines.spoken: The ambassador shall not go unpunished!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: He took it... He took it from me.
lines.spoken: He took it... He took it from me.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Took what!?
lines.spoken: Took what!?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The blessing... Phoenix's blessing.
lines.spoken: The blessing... [[fˈiːnɪksᵻz]] blessing.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: No... No!!!
lines.spoken: No... No!!!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: This blade I wield also contains the blazing life force of the avatar Phoenix.
lines.spoken: This blade I wield also contains the blazing life force of the avatar Phoenix.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: This calls to mind my own Phoenix Blade, which once contained a similar power.
lines.spoken: This calls to mind my own Phoenix Blade, which once contained a similar power.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Perhaps you recall that my blade also bears the blazing life force of Phoenix.
lines.spoken: Perhaps you recall that my blade also bears the blazing life force of Phoenix.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: When I first laid eyes on the girl...
lines.spoken: When I first laid eyes on the girl...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: A small fraction of Phoenix's essence was transfused into this cold steel.
lines.spoken: A small fraction of [[fˈiːnɪksᵻz]] essence was transfused into this cold steel.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Only one blessed by Phoenix could sense it.
lines.spoken: Only one blessed by Phoenix could sense it.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: If my blade was one of Phoenix's feathers, then Iroha herself is its wings.
lines.spoken: If my blade was one of [[fˈiːnɪksᵻz]] feathers, then [[ɪɹˈohə]] herself is its wings.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I could feel Phoenix flare up upon meeting Iroha.
lines.spoken: I could feel Phoenix flare up upon meeting [[ɪɹˈohə]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: But I cannot say that Phoenix itself is complete.
lines.spoken: But I cannot say that Phoenix itself is complete.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Yet my blade sings the praises of that young woman, feeling that in the future she may be Phoenix incarnate.
lines.spoken: Yet my blade sings the praises of that young woman, feeling that in the future she may be Phoenix incarnate.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Though only a portion of its energy was entrusted to it, let there be no doubt: in the future, Phoenix will have fully revived.
lines.spoken: Though only a portion of its energy was entrusted to it, let there be no doubt: in the future, Phoenix will have fully revived.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: The awe is...indescribable.
lines.spoken: The awe is...indescribable.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: But this is no time to wax poetic.
lines.spoken: But this is no time to wax poetic.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Once whole, Phoenix's life force will be without peer, and not even the greatest darkness can overcome it.
lines.spoken: Once whole, [[fˈiːnɪksᵻz]] life force will be without peer, and not even the greatest darkness can overcome it.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: No, even the Emptiness would fully succumb.
lines.spoken: No, even the Emptiness would fully succumb.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: But if part of Phoenix's puissance lies with Selh'teus, then how...?
lines.spoken: But if part of [[fˈiːnɪksᵻz]] puissance lies with [[sˈɛlhtɪəs]], then how...?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Not even the Emptiness that strangles the Far East.
lines.spoken: Not even the Emptiness that strangles the Far East.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: <player>, seeing what happened to Iroha, and knowing what my blade has told me, there is only one logical conclusion.
lines.spoken: adventurer, seeing what happened to [[ɪɹˈohə]], and knowing what my blade has told me, there is only one logical conclusion.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: We must wrest Phoenix's blessing back from the ambassador of the void!
lines.spoken: We must wrest [[fˈiːnɪksᵻz]] blessing back from the ambassador of the void!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Phoenix Blade, please guide us in these bleak times.
lines.spoken: Phoenix Blade, please guide us in these bleak times.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Why exactly would we need to wait?
lines.spoken: Why exactly would we need to wait?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Why're you two sitting there having a little tea party?
lines.spoken: Why're you two sitting there having a little tea party?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: My fists are aching for a workout. And you know why?
lines.spoken: My fists are aching for a workout. And you know why?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Because I laid eyes on this creepy masked man!
lines.spoken: Because I laid eyes on this creepy masked man!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: He kept yammering somethin' about being surprised to cross paths again, and that I haven't changed at all--but I've never seen that worthless piece of trash in my life!
lines.spoken: He kept yammering somethin' about being surprised to cross paths again, and that I haven't changed at all--but I've never seen that worthless piece of trash in my life!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: There you are!
lines.spoken: There you are!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Thank goodness I'm not too late.
lines.spoken: Thank goodness I'm not too late.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I stumbled upon a most vexing masked man.
lines.spoken: I stumbled upon a most vexing masked man.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: As soon as he laid eyes on me he smirked, saying that I hadn't changed one bit. I could barely stop quivering!
lines.spoken: As soon as he laid eyes on me he smirked, saying that I hadn't changed one bit. I could barely stop quivering!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: The masked man!? Tell us--where did he go?
lines.spoken: The masked man!? Tell us--where did he go?

lines.speaker: Ulmia
lines.text: I do not know, but he muttered something about an "Astral Candescence."
lines.spoken: I do not know, but he muttered something about an "Astral Candescence."

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I'll give him a couple good chops next time he shows his face around here!
lines.spoken: I'll give him a couple good chops next time he shows his face around here!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: He mighta been alone, but that decisive tone of voice--he definitely was talking with someone.
lines.spoken: He mighta been alone, but that decisive tone of voice--he definitely was talking with someone.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: There's something terribly off about him.
lines.spoken: There's something terribly off about him.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: He was alone, but...his diction was like he was talking to someone else, not himself.
lines.spoken: He was alone, but...his diction was like he was talking to someone else, not himself.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Have you heard of this little thingy called an "Astral Candescence"?
lines.spoken: Have you heard of this little thingy called an "Astral Candescence"?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: He was ranting and raving about needing to get his hands on one. What a loon!
lines.spoken: He was ranting and raving about needing to get his hands on one. What a loon!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: An Astral Candescence... The name is not altogether unfamiliar.
lines.spoken: An Astral Candescence... The name is not altogether unfamiliar.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: It is a special type of instrument found in the land of Aht Urhgan. For years I had been aching to study one, but I never had cause to visit the Empire.
lines.spoken: It is a special type of instrument found in the land of Aht [[ˈʌrhɡən]]. For years I had been aching to study one, but I never had cause to visit the Empire.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Aht-what now? What's that? Can you eat it?
lines.spoken: Aht-what now? What's that? Can you eat it?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Aht...Urhgan? Never have I heard of such a locale.
lines.spoken: Aht...[[ˈʌrhɡən]]? Never have I heard of such a locale.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: <player>, we must make haste!
lines.spoken: adventurer, we must make haste!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: One of my disciples found out that the Tenshodo in Lower Jeuno can offer us safe passage there.
lines.spoken: One of my disciples found out that the [[tɛnʃˈoʊdoʊ]] in Lower [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]] can offer us safe passage there.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Let us waste not a breath!
lines.spoken: Let us waste not a breath!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I've got a couple...errands to take care of here, but save me a piece of that masked bugger for later!
lines.spoken: I've got a couple...errands to take care of here, but save me a piece of that masked bugger for later!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I'll catch up with the two of you later. There's some unfinished business here I must take care of.
lines.spoken: I'll catch up with the two of you later. There's some unfinished business here I must take care of.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I can't help but wonder if someone...or something...is controlling him.
lines.spoken: I can't help but wonder if someone...or something...is controlling him.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: There's somethin' off about that guy, but I can't place my finger on it...
lines.spoken: There's somethin' off about that guy, but I can't place my finger on it...

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I can't help but wonder if there isn't more to this masked man than meets the eye...
lines.spoken: I can't help but wonder if there isn't more to this masked man than meets the eye...

lines.speaker: Ulmia
lines.text: <player>, may your journey be a safe one.
lines.spoken: adventurer, may your journey be a safe one.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Stupid place sounds like it's too far away for me, too--and you think we've got time to run off chasing after some stupid toy?
lines.spoken: Stupid place sounds like it's too far away for me, too--and you think we've got time to run off chasing after some stupid toy?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I fear I have not the constitution to make such a journey. And besides, isn't there stuff to take care of here in the Middle Lands first?
lines.spoken: I fear I have not the constitution to make such a journey. And besides, isn't there stuff to take care of here in the Middle Lands first?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Prishe, I understand that you may have your hands full, but you, Lord <player>!
lines.spoken: Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]], I understand that you may have your hands full, but you, Lord adventurer!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Prishe, I understand that you may have your hands full, but you, Lady <player>!
lines.spoken: Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]], I understand that you may have your hands full, but you, Lady adventurer!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ugh. Do what you will!
lines.spoken: Ugh. Do what you will!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Yo, <player>, I hauled tail as soon as I heard!
lines.spoken: Yo, adventurer, I hauled tail as soon as I heard!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Oh, my! I hear things have gotten a bit rough lately!
lines.spoken: Oh, my! I hear things have gotten a bit rough lately!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: You shoulda heard Tenzen prattle on! Dying world this, dark future that...ugh. It was all I could do not to smack him right in the kisser!
lines.spoken: You shoulda heard [[tˈɛnzən]] prattle on! Dying world this, dark future that...ugh. It was all I could do not to smack him right in the kisser!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Figured the old fart was trying to pull the wool over my eyes.
lines.spoken: Figured the old fart was trying to pull the wool over my eyes.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: C'mon. Even if the world were really in danger, all it would take is a quick few shakes of my fist and everything'd be right as rain.
lines.spoken: C'mon. Even if the world were really in danger, all it would take is a quick few shakes of my fist and everything'd be right as rain.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I mean, seriously. Right?
lines.spoken: I mean, seriously. Right?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I admit his ominous words were a bit scary. The world is dying, the future is bleak...
lines.spoken: I admit his ominous words were a bit scary. The world is dying, the future is bleak...

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Now that I'm no longer able to look deeply into people's hearts, I couldn't tell if he was playing a cruel joke.
lines.spoken: Now that I'm no longer able to look deeply into people's hearts, I couldn't tell if he was playing a cruel joke.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: But then it struck me--even if something terrible was about to happen, you'd be able to see us through it.
lines.spoken: But then it struck me--even if something terrible was about to happen, you'd be able to see us through it.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: You would, wouldn't you?
lines.spoken: You would, wouldn't you?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ah, Lady Prishe. 'Tis good to see you looking your usual chipper self.
lines.spoken: Ah, Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]]. 'Tis good to see you looking your usual chipper self.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Prishe...? Are you feeling ill?
lines.spoken: Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]]...? Are you feeling ill?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: 'Course I am.
lines.spoken: 'Course I am.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Gimme a break. You keep spewing a load of crap about the end of the world, so how else am I supposed to react?
lines.spoken: Gimme a break. You keep spewing a load of crap about the end of the world, so how else am I supposed to react?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: We already put a lid on that messy business, so there's nothing left to worry about!
lines.spoken: We already put a lid on that messy business, so there's nothing left to worry about!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Why, most certainly.
lines.spoken: Why, most certainly.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: How else would one feel when an old friend comes bearing ill tidings about the end of the world?
lines.spoken: How else would one feel when an old friend comes bearing ill tidings about the end of the world?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Have we not already solved this problem? Why would it rear its ugly head anew? It's enough to set my head swimming!
lines.spoken: Have we not already solved this problem? Why would it rear its ugly head anew? It's enough to set my head swimming!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ah, that would explain it. I must confess to having difficulty discerning my right from my left as well these past weeks...
lines.spoken: Ah, that would explain it. I must confess to having difficulty discerning my right from my left as well these past weeks...

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: This creepy old coot rushes in and starts blabbing about dying world this, dark future that...ugh. It was all I could do not to smack him right in the kisser!
lines.spoken: This creepy old coot rushes in and starts blabbing about dying world this, dark future that...ugh. It was all I could do not to smack him right in the kisser!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: The blood rushed to my head and now it's pounding like I just ran face-first into a wall!
lines.spoken: The blood rushed to my head and now it's pounding like I just ran face-first into a wall!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Ah. Well, that solves the mystery of his obnoxious prattling.
lines.spoken: Ah. Well, that solves the mystery of his obnoxious prattling.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Then this whole "Emptiness" thing's gotta be connected, right?
lines.spoken: Then this whole "Emptiness" thing's gotta be connected, right?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: And you mean to say that it's our destiny to send it packing?
lines.spoken: And you mean to say that it's our destiny to send it packing?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Old coot is so damn noisy it was like I had those three Tarutaru dancing in my head.
lines.spoken: Old coot is so damn noisy it was like I had those three [[tˈɑːɹɹuːtˌɑːɹɹuː]] dancing in my head.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Prishe, are you not the least bit concerned!?
lines.spoken: Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]], are you not the least bit concerned!?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: All those close to you, whether in Tavnazia or beyond, are in grave danger!
lines.spoken: All those close to you, whether in [[tævnˈaːziə]] or beyond, are in grave danger!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: This crazy ninja lady burst into my place in Tavnazia and dragged me over here kicking and screaming.
lines.spoken: This crazy ninja lady burst into my place in [[tævnˈaːziə]] and dragged me over here kicking and screaming.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: She said Despachiaire would never miss me, what with the way he's got his eye on Ulmia like a hawk.
lines.spoken: She said Despachiaire would never miss me, what with the way he's got his eye on [[ˈʌlmiə]] like a hawk.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Think it's safe for me to be here?
lines.spoken: Think it's safe for me to be here?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Prishe, surely Kagero explained to you the gravity of the situation.
lines.spoken: Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]], surely [[kædʒˈɛɹoʊ]] explained to you the gravity of the situation.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: All those close to you, whether in Tavnazia or beyond, are in grave danger.
lines.spoken: All those close to you, whether in [[tævnˈaːziə]] or beyond, are in grave danger.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. But what good does it do any of us to sit here with our thumbs up our butts moaning about it?
lines.spoken: Yeah, yeah. But what good does it do any of us to sit here with our thumbs up our butts moaning about it?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Less talk, more action!
lines.spoken: Less talk, more action!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: A most becoming response. But how are we to act when we know so little?
lines.spoken: A most becoming response. But how are we to act when we know so little?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Didn't you mention something 'bout a delicate little waif from the future who had all the answers?
lines.spoken: Didn't you mention something 'bout a delicate little waif from the future who had all the answers?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Unfortunately, although Iroha can see the grand picture, there are many details that escape her.
lines.spoken: Unfortunately, although [[ɪɹˈohə]] can see the grand picture, there are many details that escape her.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: The one most familiar with the situation is he who came after her.
lines.spoken: The one most familiar with the situation is he who came after her.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: This ambassador from the void guy, yeah. I've half a mind to rip that mask from his scrawny little neck and expose him for the sham he is!
lines.spoken: This ambassador from the void guy, yeah. I've half a mind to rip that mask from his scrawny little neck and expose him for the sham he is!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: And this would be your masked ambassador from the void?
lines.spoken: And this would be your masked ambassador from the void?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Would that our paths had crossed, but I know only his name.
lines.spoken: Would that our paths had crossed, but I know only his name.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: And that Lord <player> and Lady Iroha sparred with him.
lines.spoken: And that Lord adventurer and Lady [[ɪɹˈohə]] sparred with him.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: And that Lady <player> and Lady Iroha sparred with him.
lines.spoken: And that Lady adventurer and Lady [[ɪɹˈohə]] sparred with him.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: And!? Did you pop him a new one?
lines.spoken: And!? Did you pop him a new one?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: What happened then?
lines.spoken: What happened then?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: You gotta show idiots like that who's boss!
lines.spoken: You gotta show idiots like that who's boss!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Next time the pounding will come right from me!
lines.spoken: Next time the pounding will come right from me!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: So you did not come into direct conflict?
lines.spoken: So you did not come into direct conflict?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I know we can claim victory the next time if we work together!
lines.spoken: I know we can claim victory the next time if we work together!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: That's the <player> I know and love!
lines.spoken: That's the adventurer I know and love!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Hang on--you didn't actually smack him around, did you!?
lines.spoken: Hang on--you didn't actually smack him around, did you!?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Can't fool me! My fingers start to twitch whenever someone's trying to finagle their way out of the truth!
lines.spoken: Can't fool me! My fingers start to twitch whenever someone's trying to finagle their way out of the truth!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: That's wonderful news!
lines.spoken: That's wonderful news!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Wait. Was that...a joke?
lines.spoken: Wait. Was that...a joke?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: How undeniably cruel! Why would you get any enjoyment out of toying with me?
lines.spoken: How undeniably cruel! Why would you get any enjoyment out of toying with me?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Thinkin' he can just snatch victory like candy from a babe, no doubt!
lines.spoken: Thinkin' he can just snatch victory like candy from a babe, no doubt!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Let him do what he wants, I say! I'll mangle his face so bad he'll never dare to remove that mask!
lines.spoken: Let him do what he wants, I say! I'll mangle his face so bad he'll never dare to remove that mask!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: If he's as impressive as you claim, I would surely like to meet him.
lines.spoken: If he's as impressive as you claim, I would surely like to meet him.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: But goodness, my knees would certainly turn to jelly.
lines.spoken: But goodness, my knees would certainly turn to jelly.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: This is no time for nonsense. That man can call forth voids at will.
lines.spoken: This is no time for nonsense. That man can call forth voids at will.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Wait...there's something desperately wrong...
lines.spoken: Wait...there's something desperately wrong...

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Hm?
lines.spoken: Hm?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Aaaaaah!
lines.spoken: Aaaaaah!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Eeep!
lines.spoken: [[iːiːp]]!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: There is no need for concern, Lady Prishe.
lines.spoken: There is no need for concern, Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]].

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: The same thing happened earlier. The orb filling with light--this is what Iroha was mentioning, is it not?
lines.spoken: The same thing happened earlier. The orb filling with light--this is what [[ɪɹˈohə]] was mentioning, is it not?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Urk! I thought the damn thing was trying to rip my soul from my body!
lines.spoken: [[ˈɜːk]]! I thought the damn thing was trying to rip my soul from my body!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I...I felt like my soul was being ripped from my body!
lines.spoken: I...I felt like my soul was being ripped from my body!

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Prishe, I assure you no such thing would occur.
lines.spoken: Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]], I assure you no such thing would occur.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Hmph. Long as I'm still in one piece I couldn't give a flying fig.
lines.spoken: [[hʊmf]]. Long as I'm still in one piece I couldn't give a flying fig.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: But let's track back a minute to where we can find this Iroha of yours.
lines.spoken: But let's track back a minute to where we can find this [[ɪɹˈohə]] of yours.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Thank the heavens! Hopefully my shivers will calm down...
lines.spoken: Thank the heavens! Hopefully my shivers will calm down...

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: But wait--where can we find Iroha?
lines.spoken: But wait--where can we find [[ɪɹˈohə]]?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: She had promised to be here...
lines.spoken: She had promised to be here...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Do you suppose something happened to her?
lines.spoken: Do you suppose something happened to her?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Only in the most dire of circumstances is a priestess from Reisenjima Sanctorium permitted to leave the tiny island.
lines.spoken: Only in the most dire of circumstances is a priestess from [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium permitted to leave the tiny island.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: And now she might be lost in this most bustling of towns--I must find her before something happens!!!
lines.spoken: And now she might be lost in this most bustling of towns--I must find her before something happens!!!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: So you're saying she let it hurl? That can't be good.
lines.spoken: So you're saying she let it hurl? That can't be good.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Whatever shall we do?
lines.spoken: Whatever shall we do?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: A priestess's calling is to remain sheltered in her cloister and pray to the gods.
lines.spoken: A priestess's calling is to remain sheltered in her cloister and pray to the gods.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: She probably caught a whiff of some sausages or something and is gorging herself as we speak.
lines.spoken: She probably caught a whiff of some sausages or something and is gorging herself as we speak.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Perhaps the delectable scent of sausages enticed her?
lines.spoken: Perhaps the delectable scent of sausages enticed her?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady Prishe, a priestess from the Far East is not tempted by such carnal desires.
lines.spoken: Lady [[pɹˈiːʃ]], a priestess from the Far East is not tempted by such carnal desires.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Well, she must have found some stunning number and is flitting from store to store wasting ponzes of gil on cute little baubles.
lines.spoken: Well, she must have found some stunning number and is flitting from store to store wasting ponzes of gil on cute little baubles.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Well...maybe she found some delightful dress and is spending her hours at the clothiers?
lines.spoken: Well...maybe she found some delightful dress and is spending her hours at the clothiers?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ahem. Our priestesses take vows of poverty, and I highly doubt that centuries-old tradition will have changed in the future.
lines.spoken: Ahem. Our priestesses take vows of poverty, and I highly doubt that centuries-old tradition will have changed in the future.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Then I bet someone beat her up and left her lying in a ditch!
lines.spoken: Then I bet someone beat her up and left her lying in a ditch!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: What if...what if someone accosted her!?
lines.spoken: What if...what if someone accosted her!?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: D-do you think that's possible!?
lines.spoken: D-do you think that's possible!?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I must find her before it is too late!!!
lines.spoken: I must find her before it is too late!!!

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I should probably head off to find her, too.
lines.spoken: I should probably head off to find her, too.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Maybe she made her way to Lower Jeuno?
lines.spoken: Maybe she made her way to Lower [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]]?

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: This whole incident has me quite concerned. Perhaps it is best if I join in the search.
lines.spoken: This whole incident has me quite concerned. Perhaps it is best if I join in the search.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: I'll see what I can find in Lower Jeuno.
lines.spoken: I'll see what I can find in Lower [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]].

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Welcome to the mayor's residence. How can I help you?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the mayor's residence. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: I can tell you much about Selbina.
lines.spoken: I can tell you much about [[sɛlbˈiːnə]].

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Very well. Selbina was established by Bastok as a haven for ships bearing Gustaberg ore. She soon grew into a thriving port town.
lines.spoken: Very well. [[sɛlbˈiːnə]] was established by [[bˈæstɑːk]] as a haven for ships bearing [[ɡˈuːstɐbˌɜːɡ]] ore. She soon grew into a thriving port town.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Selbina declared neutrality at the outbreak of the Great War and maintains her independence to this day.
lines.spoken: [[sɛlbˈiːnə]] declared neutrality at the outbreak of the Great War and maintains her independence to this day.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Very well. Our fair town lies in the middle of Valkurm Dunes, here in central Quon.
lines.spoken: Very well. Our fair town lies in the middle of Valkurm Dunes, here in central [[kwˈɑːn]].

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Most of the coastline consists of dunes and shallows. Selbina stands atop the only suitable harbor.
lines.spoken: Most of the coastline consists of dunes and shallows. [[sɛlbˈiːnə]] stands atop the only suitable harbor.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Very well. Thanks to the harbor, industry in Selbina has prospered throughout the ages.
lines.spoken: Very well. Thanks to the harbor, industry in [[sɛlbˈiːnə]] has prospered throughout the ages.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: But airships are the wave of the future, so we are trying to develop local industries such as fishing and agriculture.
lines.spoken: But airships are the wave of the future, so we are trying to develop local industries such as fishing and agriculture.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Please come back if you have any questions. Good day.
lines.spoken: Please come back if you have any questions. Good day.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Very well. Here we have regional salesrooms of the Fishermen's and Weavers' Guilds, as well as an inn and the sea travel agency.
lines.spoken: Very well. Here we have regional salesrooms of the Fishermen's and Weavers' Guilds, as well as an inn and the sea travel agency.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: You can purchase weapons from Torapiont inside the inn, and local items from Dohdjuma in front of the warehouse.
lines.spoken: You can purchase weapons from Torapiont inside the inn, and local items from Dohdjuma in front of the warehouse.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Ah, you must be <player>.
lines.spoken: Ah, you must be adventurer.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Thank you for answering the summons. One of the mayor's confidantes has been asking for you.
lines.spoken: Thank you for answering the summons. One of the mayor's confidantes has been asking for you.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: I'm Abelard, mayor of this village. It's so tiny, you see, that all I do is mediate when there are disagreements.
lines.spoken: I'm [[ˈeɪbəlˌɑːɹd]], mayor of this village. It's so tiny, you see, that all I do is mediate when there are disagreements.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: A pira...entrepreneur associate of mine known as Gilgamesh has had your name on his lips the past several days.
lines.spoken: A pira...entrepreneur associate of mine known as [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]] has had your name on his lips the past several days.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: He rescued a young woman adrift at sea, and she spoke quite highly of you when she woke up.
lines.spoken: He rescued a young woman adrift at sea, and she spoke quite highly of you when she woke up.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: Finding you has removed one burden off my shoulders, but there remains yet another.
lines.spoken: Finding you has removed one burden off my shoulders, but there remains yet another.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: You see, Gilgamesh made a second request.
lines.spoken: You see, [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]] made a second request.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Their medicinal properties are highly valued even during times of peace, and what with the recent strange happenings...
lines.spoken: Their medicinal properties are highly valued even during times of peace, and what with the recent strange happenings...

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: You probably know what I'm going to ask.
lines.spoken: You probably know what I'm going to ask.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: Of course, your efforts will be duly rewarded.
lines.spoken: Of course, your efforts will be duly rewarded.

lines.speaker: Naillina
lines.text: Best of luck!
lines.spoken: Best of luck!

lines.speaker: Esteban
lines.text: Selbina's mayor is looking for adventurers to fulfill a special task for him. I'm not familiar with the particulars...
lines.spoken: [[sɛlbˈiːnəz]] mayor is looking for adventurers to fulfill a special task for him. I'm not familiar with the particulars...

lines.speaker: Esteban
lines.text: ...But Flandiace is. He can direct you to the mayor's residence.
lines.spoken: ...But [[flˈɑːndɪˌeɪs]] is. He can direct you to the mayor's residence.

lines.speaker: Esteban
lines.text: The mayor has been putting out the call for a particular adventurer, and I think you may be just the person he's looking for.
lines.spoken: The mayor has been putting out the call for a particular adventurer, and I think you may be just the person he's looking for.

lines.speaker: Esteban
lines.text: Make haste for his residence and see if you can lend him a hand.
lines.spoken: Make haste for his residence and see if you can lend him a hand.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: Oho! You've brought them back safely, then?
lines.spoken: Oho! You've brought them back safely, then?

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: Gilgamesh and his entourage've just arrived back in port.
lines.spoken: [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]] and his entourage've just arrived back in port.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: <player>, good t' see yer face again!
lines.spoken: adventurer, good t' see yer face again!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: So you're <player>, eh? I've heard much 'bout ya.
lines.spoken: So you're adventurer, eh? I've heard much 'bout ya.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Aye, this be just what we ordered. Now a little tit-fer-tat...
lines.spoken: Aye, this be just what we ordered. Now a little tit-fer-tat...

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: Excellent. I think adventurers would have a use for these.
lines.spoken: Excellent. I think adventurers would have a use for these.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: So here, <player>--for you.
lines.spoken: So here, adventurer--for you.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Suppose we'd best get down t' business.
lines.spoken: Suppose we'd best get down t' business.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: <player>, yer intimately familiar with my journeys as a pirate on the Bastore Sea.
lines.spoken: adventurer, yer intimately familiar with my journeys as a pirate on the [[bˈæstɔːɹ]] Sea.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: <player>, might come as a bit of a surprise to hear this, but I'm a pirate known for roamin' the Bastore Sea.
lines.spoken: adventurer, might come as a bit of a surprise to hear this, but I'm a pirate known for roamin' the [[bˈæstɔːɹ]] Sea.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: The oceans ta the west have been a bit stormier'n usual of late, an' me crew an' I came across a small vessel adrift upon the tides.
lines.spoken: The oceans ta the west have been a bit stormier'n usual of late, an' me crew an' I came across a small vessel adrift upon the tides.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: So 'course I say to meself, who'd'a thunk that such a delicate rowboat could stay whole in such a terrible brew...an' then the whole thin' started flashin' red.
lines.spoken: So 'course I say to meself, who'd'a thunk that such a delicate rowboat could stay whole in such a terrible brew...an' then the whole thin' started flashin' red.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Being the curious sailor I am, I went an' investigated. Lo and behold, there was a pretty young lass lyin' prone along the deck.
lines.spoken: Being the curious sailor I am, I went an' investigated. Lo and behold, there was a pretty young lass lyin' prone along the deck.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: I've always had quite the fondness fer the color red. Figurin' it must be a sign from Altana herself, I took her on board and brought her back with me ta Norg.
lines.spoken: I've always had quite the fondness fer the color red. Figurin' it must be a sign from [[ɔːltˈɑːnə]] herself, I took her on board and brought her back with me ta [[nɔːɹɡ]].

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: When she came to, the first words from those pale lips of hers were yer name.
lines.spoken: When she came to, the first words from those pale lips of hers were yer name.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: So I want ya ta come back ta Norg with us. She was quite insistent on meetin' ya.
lines.spoken: So I want ya ta come back ta [[nɔːɹɡ]] with us. She was quite insistent on meetin' ya.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ya see, she's gone on a bit of a...hunger strike.
lines.spoken: Ya see, she's gone on a bit of a...hunger strike.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: The ship's docked at port waitin' ta take you whenever ya've got yer affairs in order here.
lines.spoken: The ship's docked at port waitin' ta take you whenever ya've got yer affairs in order here.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: I just remembered a bit of a pressin' engagement I've gotta attend to, but I'll catch up with ya there.
lines.spoken: I just remembered a bit of a pressin' engagement I've gotta attend to, but I'll catch up with ya there.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: I...I have a request. Don't breathe a word to the populace that I aided a known pirate.
lines.spoken: I...I have a request. Don't breathe a word to the populace that I aided a known pirate.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: Their activities aren't completely on the up-and-up, but as a port town, we still depend on them.
lines.spoken: Their activities aren't completely on the up-and-up, but as a port town, we still depend on them.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: And while we're talking of aid, remember to use that item I gave you.
lines.spoken: And while we're talking of aid, remember to use that item I gave you.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: Isacio here in town will know what to do with it.
lines.spoken: Isacio here in town will know what to do with it.

lines.speaker: Abelard
lines.text: I'm sure it'll aid you in your travels.
lines.spoken: I'm sure it'll aid you in your travels.

lines.speaker: Pacomart
lines.text: We're settin' sail fer Norg, landlubber! Hopefully you can handle the rough seas.
lines.spoken: We're settin' sail fer [[nɔːɹɡ]], landlubber! Hopefully you can handle the rough seas.

lines.speaker: Pacomart
lines.text: Hoist the sails, mateys! We're off!
lines.spoken: Hoist the sails, mateys! We're off!

lines.speaker: Pacomart
lines.text: Bwahaha, take all the time ye need!
lines.spoken: [[bwˈɑːhˌɑːhɑː]], take all the time ye need!

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Welcome to the governor's house. How may I be of assistance?
lines.spoken: Welcome to the governor's house. How may I be of assistance?

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: As you wish. Mhaura is a port town situated within the boundaries of the Windurstian Federation.
lines.spoken: As you wish. [[mˈɔːɹə]] is a port town situated within the boundaries of the [[wˈɪndɜːstʃən]] Federation.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: The natural basin here was ideal for building a port. In time, people started building their homes in the surrounding cliffs. Thus Mhaura came to be.
lines.spoken: The natural basin here was ideal for building a port. In time, people started building their homes in the surrounding cliffs. Thus [[mˈɔːɹə]] came to be.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Geographically, Mhaura is situated in the southern half of the Buburimu Peninsula in Southeastern Mindartia. Windurst City is southwest of here.
lines.spoken: Geographically, [[mˈɔːɹə]] is situated in the southern half of the [[bˈuːbuːɹˌiːmuː]] Peninsula in Southeastern [[mɪndˈaːɹʃə]]. [[wˈɪndɜːst]] City is southwest of here.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: From the port, you can board one of the transit ships to Selbina, a town in Central Quon.
lines.spoken: From the port, you can board one of the transit ships to [[sɛlbˈiːnə]], a town in Central [[kwˈɑːn]].

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Lately, there are even ships traveling to a city called Al Zahbi in the Near Eastern Empire of Aht Urhgan.
lines.spoken: Lately, there are even ships traveling to a city called Al [[zˈɑːbiː]] in the Near Eastern Empire of Aht [[ˈʌrhɡən]].

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: As you wish. The Blacksmiths' Guild and Goldsmiths' Guild have their salesrooms on the level below us.
lines.spoken: As you wish. The Blacksmiths' Guild and Goldsmiths' Guild have their salesrooms on the level below us.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Across from them spans a bridge leading to a two-story inn called the Sailors' Stay. The reception desk is on the first floor. The armorer, Graine, is also there.
lines.spoken: Across from them spans a bridge leading to a two-story inn called the Sailors' Stay. The reception desk is on the first floor. The armorer, Graine, is also there.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Across the Sailors' Stay, on ground level, is the sea travel agency. Ships bound for Selbina and Al Zahbi dock there.
lines.spoken: Across the Sailors' Stay, on ground level, is the sea travel agency. Ships bound for [[sɛlbˈiːnə]] and Al [[zˈɑːbiː]] dock there.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: To the west of the agency you'll find an antique shop. I should tell you that the owner, Orlando, has some very peculiar tastes...
lines.spoken: To the west of the agency you'll find an antique shop. I should tell you that the owner, Orlando, has some very peculiar tastes...

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Further west, down a flight of stairs, is the warehouse.
lines.spoken: Further west, down a flight of stairs, is the warehouse.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Pikini-Mikini, a dealer in goods, and Tya Padolih, a seller of arcane scrolls, have set up shop there.
lines.spoken: [[pɪkˈiːnɪ mɪkˈiːnɪ]], a dealer in goods, and Tya Padolih, a seller of arcane scrolls, have set up shop there.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Have you gone to see Take at the Sailors' Stay yet? She may have something for you.
lines.spoken: Have you gone to see Take at the Sailors' Stay yet? She may have something for you.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Jobs in Mhaura? Hmm... I believe Lady Take at the Sailors' Stay is the person to talk to about such matters.
lines.spoken: Jobs in [[mˈɔːɹə]]? Hmm... I believe Lady Take at the Sailors' Stay is the person to talk to about such matters.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: As you wish. Please come by anytime if there is something you wish to ask about Mhaura.
lines.spoken: As you wish. Please come by anytime if there is something you wish to ask about [[mˈɔːɹə]].

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Ah, I was told to expect someone named <player>. Would that be you?
lines.spoken: Ah, I was told to expect someone named adventurer. Would that be you?

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Forgive me for not recognizing you sooner. I had been told to be on the lookout and usher you into the governor's office without delay.
lines.spoken: Forgive me for not recognizing you sooner. I had been told to be on the lookout and usher you into the governor's office without delay.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: Oh, this is wonderful, indeed! I was worried I'd have to hunt and peck for you all down the coast.
lines.spoken: Oh, this is wonderful, indeed! I was worried I'd have to hunt and peck for you all down the coast.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: I, Ekokoko, serve as the governor of our bright town.
lines.spoken: I, Ekokoko, serve as the governor of our bright town.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: Truth be told, I was not the one who sought you out. No, that would be Gilgamesh, one of Vana'diel's most renowned pir--er, entrepreneurs.
lines.spoken: Truth be told, I was not the one who sought you out. No, that would be [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]], one of [[vɑːnɑːdjɛlz]] most renowned pir--er, entrepreneurs.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: Something about setting sail and finding someone lost at sea? Bah, I never had much of a head for details.
lines.spoken: Something about setting sail and finding someone lost at sea? Bah, I never had much of a head for details.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: What I do know is that your name came up on more than one occasion.
lines.spoken: What I do know is that your name came up on more than one occasion.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: He hopes to use it to create a special herbal remedy for his crew--er, associates.
lines.spoken: He hopes to use it to create a special herbal remedy for his crew--er, associates.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: The world has been bursting at the seams with odd news these days, and frankly, none of us here can make heads or tails of it all.
lines.spoken: The world has been bursting at the seams with odd news these days, and frankly, none of us here can make heads or tails of it all.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: I'll call Gilgamesh back to port immediately.
lines.spoken: I'll call [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]] back to port immediately.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: And yes, I am well aware that adventurers often charge a fee for their services, and I will personally see to it that you are properly recompensed.

lines.speaker: Numi Adaligo
lines.text: Come back soon!
lines.spoken: Come back soon!

lines.speaker: Marilionne
lines.text: An adventurer, are you not? Perhaps it would behoove you to speak to our esteemed governor.
lines.spoken: An adventurer, are you not? Perhaps it would behoove you to speak to our esteemed governor.

lines.speaker: Marilionne
lines.text: There is doubtless a mountain of work around here that needs a steady hand. Somo Aatsula can show you the way.
lines.spoken: There is doubtless a mountain of work around here that needs a steady hand. Somo Aatsula can show you the way.

lines.speaker: Marilionne
lines.text: Ah, you must be the adventurer the governor was looking for!
lines.spoken: Ah, you must be the adventurer the governor was looking for!

lines.speaker: Marilionne
lines.text: She has been putting out a call for days now--see if you can lend her a hand.
lines.spoken: She has been putting out a call for days now--see if you can lend her a hand.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: How fabulous that you made it back safe, <player>!
lines.spoken: How fabulous that you made it back safe, adventurer!
