lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: So you're <player>, eh? I've 'eard much 'bout ya.
lines.spoken: So you're adventurer, eh? I've 'eard much 'bout ya.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: Always too kind, Gilgamesh. Here, <player>--one for you, too.
lines.spoken: Always too kind, [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]]. Here, adventurer--one for you, too.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: A-ahem. One last thing before you go. Please, please breathe no word to the citizens about me abetting a known pirate.
lines.spoken: A-ahem. One last thing before you go. Please, please breathe no word to the citizens about me abetting a known pirate.

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: They might not all understand that a port town is only looking out for its best interests when it ensures that those less on the...up-and-up remain happy. When push comes to shove, aren't we all just looking out for each other?
lines.spoken: They might not all understand that a port town is only looking out for its best interests when it ensures that those less on the...up-and-up remain happy. When push comes to shove, aren't we all just looking out for each other?

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: And while I'm not biting the hand that feeds me, I'd like to inform you that the token I have just offered is highly valued here in Mhaura.
lines.spoken: And while I'm not biting the hand that feeds me, I'd like to inform you that the token I have just offered is highly valued here in [[mˈɔːɹə]].

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: Why don't you have a brief chat with Vera here before you leave for Norg?
lines.spoken: Why don't you have a brief chat with Vera here before you leave for [[nɔːɹɡ]]?

lines.speaker: Ekokoko
lines.text: I can only hope that you appreciate its value.
lines.spoken: I can only hope that you appreciate its value.

lines.speaker: Tonasav
lines.text: We're settin' sail fer Norg, landlubber! Hopefully you can handle the rough seas.
lines.spoken: We're settin' sail fer [[nɔːɹɡ]], landlubber! Hopefully you can handle the rough seas.

lines.speaker: Tonasav
lines.text: Hoist the sails, mateys! We're off!
lines.spoken: Hoist the sails, mateys! We're off!

lines.speaker: Tonasav
lines.text: Bwahaha, take all the time ye need!
lines.spoken: [[bwˈɑːhˌɑːhɑː]], take all the time ye need!

lines.text: Didya get bumped about by the waves on yer way here, <player>? No matter. The boss be waitin' inside fer ya.
lines.spoken: Didya get bumped about by the waves on yer way here, adventurer? No matter. The boss be waitin' inside fer ya.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Oho! Would ya look who's decided ta join us!
lines.spoken: Oho! Would ya look who's decided ta join us!

lines.text: Master!
lines.spoken: Master!

lines.text: I am both humbled and honored to be able to exchange words with you once more.
lines.spoken: I am both humbled and honored to be able to exchange words with you once more.

lines.text: I have followed your instructions to the letter. Months upon years have I toiled, seeking guidance from both man and the heavens, never once letting my training or dedication falter.
lines.spoken: I have followed your instructions to the letter. Months upon years have I toiled, seeking guidance from both man and the heavens, never once letting my training or dedication falter.

lines.text: All this I have done so that we may meet once more.
lines.spoken: All this I have done so that we may meet once more.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Unworthy though your disciple Iroha may be, her words and emotions are true.
lines.spoken: Unworthy though your disciple [[ɪɹˈohə]] may be, her words and emotions are true.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ya got krill in yer ears, boy? She's callin' you her master!
lines.spoken: Ya got krill in yer ears, boy? She's callin' you her master!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ya got krill in yer ears, girl? She's callin' you her master!
lines.spoken: Ya got krill in yer ears, girl? She's callin' you her master!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: What's all this malarkey?
lines.spoken: What's all this malarkey?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Do not get angry at him. It is only natural that he not remember me.
lines.spoken: Do not get angry at him. It is only natural that he not remember me.

lines.text: Do not get angry at her. It is only natural that she not remember me.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I have wholly lost track of what year this is. 884, correct?
lines.spoken: I have wholly lost track of what year this is. 884, correct?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: This time is many, many years before I came to be, and my presence here is somewhat of an anomaly.
lines.spoken: This time is many, many years before I came to be, and my presence here is somewhat of an anomaly.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Did ya hit yer head 'fore I found ya floating adrift or somethin'?
lines.spoken: Did ya hit yer head 'fore I found ya floating adrift or somethin'?

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: You mean to say...that you haven't been born yet?
lines.spoken: You mean to say...that you haven't been born yet?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Then how'd ya get here?
lines.spoken: Then how'd ya get here?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I come from an age far in the future, when Vana'diel stands on a precipice--and the master is the only one who can guide me.
lines.spoken: I come from an age far in the future, when [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]] stands on a precipice--and the master is the only one who can guide me.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: So you mean to say that <player>...is this master of yours?
lines.spoken: So you mean to say that adventurer...is this master of yours?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: And from that outfit yer wearing, I'd wager ya were born in the Far East.
lines.spoken: And from that outfit yer wearing, I'd wager ya were born in the Far East.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: That is correct. I am the guardian of Reisenjima Sanctorium, and have a strong link with the heavens as its chief priestess.
lines.spoken: That is correct. I am the guardian of [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium, and have a strong link with the heavens as its chief priestess.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Oho. I know the particulars of the eastern faith are a bit foreign ta the rest of us, but Altana remains a central figure even there.
lines.spoken: Oho. I know the particulars of the eastern faith are a bit foreign ta the rest of us, but [[ɔːltˈɑːnə]] remains a central figure even there.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: So that'd make ya a religious authority, then?
lines.spoken: So that'd make ya a religious authority, then?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: And let me guess. The power of the spirits sent you back ta our time?
lines.spoken: And let me guess. The power of the spirits sent you back ta our time?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: They set me adrift so that I may prevent the darkness which has engulfed my era.
lines.spoken: They set me adrift so that I may prevent the darkness which has engulfed my era.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: What's this then? You're going to have to be a bit more straightforward.
lines.spoken: What's this then? You're going to have to be a bit more straightforward.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: Does this mean that the beastmen end up victorious in the end? Or is it something far more nefarious?
lines.spoken: Does this mean that the beastmen end up victorious in the end? Or is it something far more nefarious?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, do I have your leave to show them our reality?
lines.spoken: Master, do I have your leave to show them our reality?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ahem! Who do ya think risked life and limb to save your pupil there from becomin' shark chow!?
lines.spoken: Ahem! Who do ya think risked life and limb to save your pupil there from becomin' shark chow!?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: By your will.
lines.spoken: By your will.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: In the age from whence I hail, Vana'diel is gripped in the vise of fear.
lines.spoken: In the age from whence I hail, [[vɑːnɑːdjɛl]] is gripped in the vise of fear.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: In my homeland, we refer to it as "Emptiness," a blanket of darkness that infects all it touches.
lines.spoken: In my homeland, we refer to it as "Emptiness," a blanket of darkness that infects all it touches.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The master is our only light of hope. He halted the advance of such a sinister force once, and we are confident that he can do it again.
lines.spoken: The master is our only light of hope. He halted the advance of such a sinister force once, and we are confident that he can do it again.

lines.text: The master is our only light of hope. She halted the advance of such a sinister force once, and we are confident that she can do it again.
lines.spoken: The master is our only light of hope. She halted the advance of such a sinister force once, and we are confident that she can do it again.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The master and his comrades strove tirelessly for a brighter future, and their tale is known by all in time.
lines.spoken: The master and his comrades strove tirelessly for a brighter future, and their tale is known by all in time.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The master and her comrades strove tirelessly for a brighter future, and their tale is known by all in time.
lines.spoken: The master and her comrades strove tirelessly for a brighter future, and their tale is known by all in time.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Many months and years passed. I came to be in this world and trained diligently under the master's gentle hand. Yet it was not long before the skies began to cloud...both figuratively and literally.
lines.spoken: Many months and years passed. I came to be in this world and trained diligently under the master's gentle hand. Yet it was not long before the skies began to cloud...both figuratively and literally.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It descended like a thick miasma, stifling the land under a blanket of silence.
lines.spoken: It descended like a thick miasma, stifling the land under a blanket of silence.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I looked into the master's eyes and could see the truth. My homeland was not the only victim. Quon, Mindartia, Adoulin...
lines.spoken: I looked into the master's eyes and could see the truth. My homeland was not the only victim. [[kwˈɑːn]], [[mɪndˈaːɹʃə]], [[ɐdˈuːlɪn]]...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The end times were upon us, and both man and Goddess were powerless to stop it.
lines.spoken: The end times were upon us, and both man and Goddess were powerless to stop it.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: But then...how did ya survive?
lines.spoken: But then...how did ya survive?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The master and my father sacrificed themselves.
lines.spoken: The master and my father sacrificed themselves.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: My mother is from an island known as Reisenjima, the land where the final struggle took place.
lines.spoken: My mother is from an island known as [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]], the land where the final struggle took place.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Vanquishing the Emptiness was but a fantasy. It was all I could do to erect a barrier to halt its advance.
lines.spoken: Vanquishing the Emptiness was but a fantasy. It was all I could do to erect a barrier to halt its advance.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: A Pyrrhic victory, indeed, as the walls of Reisenjima's sanctorum could do naught but echo back my own solitary cries.
lines.spoken: A Pyrrhic victory, indeed, as the walls of Reisenjima's sanctorum could do naught but echo back my own solitary cries.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I was trapped for several years, when a spirit descended from the heavens to alight on a nearby brazier.
lines.spoken: I was trapped for several years, when a spirit descended from the heavens to alight on a nearby brazier.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: She told me that there was only one speck of hope that could save us...
lines.spoken: She told me that there was only one speck of hope that could save us...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The master. I was to find the master and join my light with his.
lines.spoken: The master. I was to find the master and join my light with his.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The master. I was to find the master and join my light with hers.
lines.spoken: The master. I was to find the master and join my light with hers.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The spirits opened a path for me, guiding me back here...to this point in Vana'diel's history.
lines.spoken: The spirits opened a path for me, guiding me back here...to this point in [[vɑːnɑːdjɛlz]] history.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, I would like to give you this, lest I forget to do so at a later juncture.
lines.spoken: Master, I would like to give you this, lest I forget to do so at a later juncture.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: From what you told me, there will be many trials posed to you before you finally set foot in the land you know today as the Far East.
lines.spoken: From what you told me, there will be many trials posed to you before you finally set foot in the land you know today as the Far East.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Keep this by your side and the path will remain open to you, always.
lines.spoken: Keep this by your side and the path will remain open to you, always.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Follow its guidance and it will lead you unfailingly to my time. However...
lines.spoken: Follow its guidance and it will lead you unfailingly to my time. However...

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Now jus' hang on a minute. If we jus' follow it without doin' anythin' else, we'll just end up at yer apocalyptic future where yer the only one left alive, right?
lines.spoken: Now jus' hang on a minute. If we jus' follow it without doin' anythin' else, we'll just end up at yer apocalyptic future where yer the only one left alive, right?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: ...That is correct. However, the master surely has the capacity to experience both futures...one with the Emptiness, and one without.
lines.spoken: ...That is correct. However, the master surely has the capacity to experience both futures...one with the Emptiness, and one without.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Please...find a way to...to...
lines.spoken: Please...find a way to...to...

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I cannot...stay...long...
lines.spoken: I cannot...stay...long...

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: What in blazes--!?
lines.spoken: What in blazes--!?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: <player>, I can't make heads or tails of the whole thing. Think she's tellin' the truth?
lines.spoken: adventurer, I can't make heads or tails of the whole thing. Think she's tellin' the truth?

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: This warrants further study. I'll see if my agents can pick up on anything.
lines.spoken: This warrants further study. I'll see if my agents can pick up on anything.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: <Sigh> I've ne'er been too good at dealin' with complex twists and turns.
lines.spoken: <Sigh> I've ne'er been too good at dealin' with complex twists and turns.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Gimme some time ta collect me thoughts.
lines.spoken: Gimme some time ta collect me thoughts.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Maybe there is somethin' ta that tale Iroha spun. There've been more an' more oddities happenin' of late.
lines.spoken: Maybe there is somethin' ta that tale [[ɪɹˈohə]] spun. There've been more an' more oddities happenin' of late.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: All manner of ne'er-before-seen beasts...people gettin' lost in places that look familiar but are somehow a bit off...and so much more that I could mention.
lines.spoken: All manner of ne'er-before-seen beasts...people gettin' lost in places that look familiar but are somehow a bit off...and so much more that I could mention.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: At first I figured the beastmen were behind it all, but now I'm not so sure.
lines.spoken: At first I figured the beastmen were behind it all, but now I'm not so sure.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: We gotta take stock of the situation and dig up any common threads.
lines.spoken: We gotta take stock of the situation and dig up any common threads.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ideally, you'd be wantin' to talk to my daughter, Lion.
lines.spoken: Ideally, you'd be wantin' to talk to my daughter, Lion.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: A bit of a tomboy, that one, but there're none in the Middle Lands as could match her clue-gathering skills.
lines.spoken: A bit of a tomboy, that one, but there're none in the Middle Lands as could match her clue-gathering skills.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: There's just the small question of where she ran off ta this time.
lines.spoken: There's just the small question of where she ran off ta this time.

lines.speaker: Kamui
lines.text: We made Norg our headquarters about thirty years ago.
lines.spoken: We made [[nɔːɹɡ]] our headquarters about thirty years ago.

lines.speaker: Kamui
lines.text: She bolted out of here a couple of days ago, asserting that the best way to ascertain the Beastman Confederate's plans was to put out feelers amongst allies in the three nations.
lines.spoken: She bolted out of here a couple of days ago, asserting that the best way to ascertain the Beastman Confederate's plans was to put out feelers amongst allies in the three nations.

lines.speaker: Kamui
lines.text: It stands to reason, then, that she's either in Bastok, San d'Oria, or Windurst.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Then ya might run across her durin' the course of some beastmen-related missions.
lines.spoken: Then ya might run across her durin' the course of some beastmen-related missions.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Head back to yer home nation and follow up on that threat first.
lines.spoken: Head back to yer home nation and follow up on that threat first.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Normally I'd entrust this to me daughter, Lion...
lines.spoken: Normally I'd entrust this to me daughter, Lion...

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: She was a bit of a tomboy, and there was none better than her at findin' stuff out.
lines.spoken: She was a bit of a tomboy, and there was none better than her at findin' stuff out.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: But now she's...she's... Well, maybe ya can find somethin' we can't.
lines.spoken: But now she's...she's... Well, maybe ya can find somethin' we can't.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Hey, turn that thing off!
lines.spoken: Hey, turn that thing off!

lines.text: ...Holla...Dem...Mea... Seek...the crystal...
lines.spoken: ...Holla...Dem...Mea... Seek...the crystal...

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: What was that light all about?
lines.spoken: What was that light all about?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: A voice, ya say? I didn't hear a blasted thing.
lines.spoken: A voice, ya say? I didn't hear a blasted thing.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: But hey, if ya say so, then ya probably did. Hopefully it gave ya something to go on--which is a darn sight better than anything I can do.
lines.spoken: But hey, if ya say so, then ya probably did. Hopefully it gave ya something to go on--which is a darn sight better than anything I can do.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: At least, Lion has a keen eye for these things.
lines.spoken: At least, Lion has a keen eye for these things.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: She's slowly regainin' her strength, but it's still not uncommon for her to spend the whole mornin' in bed either...
lines.spoken: She's slowly regainin' her strength, but it's still not uncommon for her to spend the whole mornin' in bed either...

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Wh-what's goin' on?
lines.spoken: Wh-what's goin' on?

lines.text: ...Holla...Dem...Mea... Seek...the crystals...
lines.spoken: ...Holla...Dem...Mea... Seek...the crystals...

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ya made it back!
lines.spoken: Ya made it back!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Iroha's been pacin' back an' forth all day.
lines.spoken: [[ˈɪɹoʊhəz]] been pacin' back an' forth all day.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, tales of your victory against the Shadow Lord has reached our ears!
lines.spoken: Master, tales of your victory against the Shadow Lord has reached our ears!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: History is one battle closer to being set on the proper course.
lines.spoken: History is one battle closer to being set on the proper course.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Upon my return, I spent hours turning over the master's words in my mind, and something came to gnaw at me.
lines.spoken: Upon my return, I spent hours turning over the master's words in my mind, and something came to gnaw at me.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I cannot shake the feeling it is related to what Lady Lion prophesized in Escha about the master's role in the coming battle against the darkness.
lines.spoken: I cannot shake the feeling it is related to what Lady Lion prophesized in Escha about the master's role in the coming battle against the darkness.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: ...and also brings us closer ta oblivion.
lines.spoken: ...and also brings us closer ta oblivion.

lines.text: Somethin' 'bout yer orb needin' ta gain light?
lines.spoken: Somethin' 'bout yer orb needin' ta gain light?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: "I felt the crystal resonate within."
lines.spoken: "I felt the crystal resonate within."

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Please, try to think back.

lines.text: Warrior of the Crystal--one who will become known as a Warrior of Light...

lines.text: You have traveled across land, sea, and sky, bathed in the light and stopping darkness wherever it threatens the living.
lines.spoken: You have traveled across land, sea, and sky, bathed in the light and stopping darkness wherever it threatens the living.

lines.spoken: You will travel across land, sea, and sky, bathed in the light and stopping darkness wherever it threatens the living.

lines.text: And you will continue to banish the doubt that resides within you.

lines.text: Banish the doubt that lies within and let radiance fill your soul.
lines.spoken: Banish the doubt that lies within and let radiance fill your soul.

lines.text: Such travels take their toll on lesser mortals, who retire to their homes and live out their lives in comfort.
lines.spoken: Such travels take their toll on lesser mortals, who retire to their homes and live out their lives in comfort.

lines.text: But although you may stop briefly to gather your wits, each time you do so it is only to steel your resolve for the next struggle.
lines.spoken: But although you may stop briefly to gather your wits, each time you do so it is only to steel your resolve for the next struggle.

lines.text: You have the will to shelter the downtrodden, vex the darkness, and protect all that Altana holds dear.
lines.spoken: You have the will to shelter the downtrodden, vex the darkness, and protect all that [[ɔːltˈɑːnə]] holds dear.

lines.text: The time is right for you to become more than a mere warrior.
lines.spoken: The time is right for you to become more than a mere warrior.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Has it come back to you, Master?
lines.spoken: Has it come back to you, Master?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You recalled with reverence those words, saying they gave you the strength of spirit to carry on no matter the odds.
lines.spoken: You recalled with reverence those words, saying they gave you the strength of spirit to carry on no matter the odds.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Though your journeys were arduous and fraught with peril, the twinkle in your eyes as you recounted your tales gave me courage.
lines.spoken: Though your journeys were arduous and fraught with peril, the twinkle in your eyes as you recounted your tales gave me courage.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: The reason you were able to lead us in the final struggle was precisely because of those many barriers you had overcome.
lines.spoken: The reason you were able to lead us in the final struggle was precisely because of those many barriers you had overcome.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You taught me that the world was worth fighting for, no matter how bleak the future.
lines.spoken: You taught me that the world was worth fighting for, no matter how bleak the future.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: My father always spoke of you with adoration, believing that you were a man of indisputable valor.
lines.spoken: My father always spoke of you with adoration, believing that you were a man of indisputable valor.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: My father always spoke of you with adoration, believing that you were a woman of indisputable valor.
lines.spoken: My father always spoke of you with adoration, believing that you were a woman of indisputable valor.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Banish your doubt, Master, so that you may become all you were meant to be!
lines.spoken: Banish your doubt, Master, so that you may become all you were meant to be!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You have conquered much, and the time has come to fill yourself with radiance!
lines.spoken: You have conquered much, and the time has come to fill yourself with radiance!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Now that ya mention it, Iroha, just who is this father of yers?
lines.spoken: Now that ya mention it, [[ɪɹˈohə]], just who is this father of yers?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Well...
lines.spoken: Well...

lines.speaker: Eunsoo
lines.text: Boss!!! Somethin' terrible has happened!
lines.spoken: Boss!!! Somethin' terrible has happened!

lines.speaker: Eunsoo
lines.text: There's big trouble at Sea Serpent Grotto!
lines.spoken: There's big trouble at Sea Serpent Grotto!

lines.speaker: Eunsoo
lines.text: Boats are just turnin' and turnin' and no one can leave!
lines.spoken: Boats are just turnin' and turnin' and no one can leave!

lines.speaker: Gottna
lines.text: No boats are able ta make it ta Norg at all!
lines.spoken: No boats are able ta make it ta [[nɔːɹɡ]] at all!

lines.speaker: Gottna
lines.text: There was this infernal ringin' noise an' the boats are just spinnin' in place!
lines.spoken: There was this infernal ringin' noise an' the boats are just spinnin' in place!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ya mean ta say that all of this started happenin' at once?
lines.spoken: Ya mean ta say that all of this started happenin' at once?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: ...Wait. "Turnin' round and round..." "Spinnin' in place..."
lines.spoken: ...Wait. "Turnin' round and round..." "Spinnin' in place..."

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Obviously they're both caused by the same thing.
lines.spoken: Obviously they're both caused by the same thing.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: The bell...
lines.spoken: The bell...

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Does this mean ya know somethin', Zeid? <player>?
lines.spoken: Does this mean ya know somethin', [[zˈaɪd]]? adventurer?

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: <player>, think back. We heard something similar in Escha, at the place that looked like the Sanctuary of Zi'Tah.
lines.spoken: adventurer, think back. We heard something similar in Escha, at the place that looked like the Sanctuary of [[zɪɾˈaː]].

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Exactly. I have the same thought.
lines.spoken: Exactly. I have the same thought.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Aha. So if ya two have experienced the same thing, then there's no one better ta get ta the bottom of this.
lines.spoken: Aha. So if ya two have experienced the same thing, then there's no one better ta get ta the bottom of this.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: We should head to the grotto, <player>, but it'll be quicker if we split up. I'll go on ahead while you prepare.
lines.spoken: We should head to the grotto, adventurer, but it'll be quicker if we split up. I'll go on ahead while you prepare.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, I insist on accompanying you!
lines.spoken: Master, I insist on accompanying you!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Zeid here's told me 'bout how you resolved our li'l problem.
lines.spoken: [[zˈaɪd]] here's told me 'bout how you resolved our li'l problem.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: It concerns me that Iroha wasn't the only one who came from the future.
lines.spoken: It concerns me that [[ɪɹˈohə]] wasn't the only one who came from the future.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Perhaps she would be able to answer some of our questions...
lines.spoken: Perhaps she would be able to answer some of our questions...

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: If she were still here.
lines.spoken: If she were still here.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: But Aldo may've found us someone who can help us anyway. Isn't that right?
lines.spoken: But [[ˈɔːldoʊ]] may've found us someone who can help us anyway. Isn't that right?

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: I've managed to find someone familiar with Reisenjima Sanctorium.
lines.spoken: I've managed to find someone familiar with [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: <player>, have you made the acquaintance of one known as Tenzen?
lines.spoken: adventurer, have you made the acquaintance of one known as [[tˈɛnzən]]?

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: I see. Then I scarce need to remind you that he is a warrior hailing from the Far East.
lines.spoken: I see. Then I scarce need to remind you that he is a warrior hailing from the Far East.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: I see. Perhaps the name gives it away, but he is a warrior hailing from the Far East.
lines.spoken: I see. Perhaps the name gives it away, but he is a warrior hailing from the Far East.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: Are you certain? He claims to have a prior relationship with you.
lines.spoken: Are you certain? He claims to have a prior relationship with you.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: Some time ago, he appeared in Jeuno to appeal for aid to the Duke Vicarious...something about an "Emptiness" threatening to consume his homeland.
lines.spoken: Some time ago, he appeared in [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]] to appeal for aid to the Duke Vicarious...something about an "Emptiness" threatening to consume his homeland.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: This Emptiness thing of his surely must have some connection to the future Iroha was on about.
lines.spoken: This Emptiness thing of his surely must have some connection to the future [[ɪɹˈohə]] was on about.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Indeed. Remember, <player>, that Siren mentioned a future without time?
lines.spoken: Indeed. Remember, adventurer, that Siren mentioned a future without time?

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: But back to this Tenzen...where is he?
lines.spoken: But back to this [[tˈɛnzən]]...where is he?

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: Word is that he concluded his business here and returned to his homeland.
lines.spoken: Word is that he concluded his business here and returned to his homeland.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: He journeys throughout the Middle Lands, but I couldn't tell you any more.
lines.spoken: He journeys throughout the Middle Lands, but I couldn't tell you any more.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: I'm having my men put out feelers.
lines.spoken: I'm having my men put out feelers.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Good work, Aldo. See what ya can find out.
lines.spoken: Good work, [[ˈɔːldoʊ]]. See what ya can find out.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Even if we succeed in findin' him, <player>, we can't be sure he'll have any answers.
lines.spoken: Even if we succeed in findin' him, adventurer, we can't be sure he'll have any answers.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: But we won't know until we find him.
lines.spoken: But we won't know until we find him.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: In the interim, I will keep learning what I can about our imposter Zi'Tah.
lines.spoken: In the interim, I will keep learning what I can about our imposter [[zɪɾˈaː]].

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Here's a bit of a trifle from Jeuno. May it help you find answers...answers we need now more than ever...
lines.spoken: Here's a bit of a trifle from [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]]. May it help you find answers...answers we need now more than ever...

lines.speaker: Heillal
lines.text: Go right on in. The boss is waitin' for ya.
lines.spoken: Go right on in. The boss is waitin' for ya.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: Gilgamesh, I'm afraid the rumors are true. Another rift has split the ground in Misareaux Coast in twain.
lines.spoken: [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]], I'm afraid the rumors are true. Another rift has split the ground in [[mˈɪsɛrˌoʊ]] Coast in twain.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Then it's th' same deal as with Qufim Island? This place the lot of ya keep referrin' to as "Escha"?
lines.spoken: Then it's th' same deal as with [[kuːfˈiːm]] Island? This place the lot of ya keep referrin' to as "Escha"?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Damned ambassador of the void! He'd better not show his face 'round here in Norg, or it's right ta Davy Jones's locker with him!
lines.spoken: Damned ambassador of the void! He'd better not show his face 'round here in [[nɔːɹɡ]], or it's right ta Davy Jones's locker with him!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Oho, if it isn't <player>! Our friend from the Far East has stopped to pay his regards.
lines.spoken: Oho, if it isn't adventurer! Our friend from the Far East has stopped to pay his regards.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I am Tenzen, a humble warrior with roots planted firmly in the Far East. May our meeting bear fruit.
lines.spoken: I am [[tˈɛnzən]], a humble warrior with roots planted firmly in the Far East. May our meeting bear fruit.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ah, I recognize that visage...
lines.spoken: Ah, I recognize that visage...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ah, Lord <player>. Your presence here is a boon.
lines.spoken: Ah, Lord adventurer. Your presence here is a boon.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ah, Lady <player>. Your presence here is a boon.
lines.spoken: Ah, Lady adventurer. Your presence here is a boon.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I shall be brief. Word reached me that a priestess from Reisenjima Sanctorium had cause to step foot here in the Middle Lands, and I came to pay my respects.
lines.spoken: I shall be brief. Word reached me that a priestess from [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium had cause to step foot here in the Middle Lands, and I came to pay my respects.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Yet I arrive here only to find that she has gone missing.
lines.spoken: Yet I arrive here only to find that she has gone missing.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: <player>, I suppose ya haven't bumped inta Iroha?
lines.spoken: adventurer, I suppose ya haven't bumped inta [[ɪɹˈohə]]?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Iroha...a magnificent name, and I trust with a character to match.
lines.spoken: [[ɪɹˈohə]]...a magnificent name, and I trust with a character to match.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ya happen ta know anythin' 'bout her? 'Cause she sure threw th' lot of us for quite the loop.
lines.spoken: Ya happen ta know anythin' 'bout her? 'Cause she sure threw th' lot of us for quite the loop.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I have extensively questioned those at Reisenjima Sanctorium, but to a man they shook their heads at each inquiry.
lines.spoken: I have extensively questioned those at [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium, but to a man they shook their heads at each inquiry.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Of course, if your story is true and she has not yet been born, then such a conclusion is foregone.
lines.spoken: Of course, if your story is true and she has not yet been born, then such a conclusion is foregone.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lord <player>, permit me to examine the orb she bequeathed unto you.
lines.spoken: Lord adventurer, permit me to examine the orb she bequeathed unto you.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady <player>, permit me to examine the orb she bequeathed unto you.
lines.spoken: Lady adventurer, permit me to examine the orb she bequeathed unto you.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: ...Intriguing. Yes, it bears the mark of Reisenjima Sanctorium.
lines.spoken: ...Intriguing. Yes, it bears the mark of [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium.

lines.speaker: Aldo
lines.text: What in blazes--!?
lines.spoken: What in blazes--!?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Calm yerself, Aldo. She's with our guest.
lines.spoken: Calm yerself, [[ˈɔːldoʊ]]. She's with our guest.

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: This orb connects the bearer with the mothercrystal.
lines.spoken: This orb connects the bearer with the mothercrystal.

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: This orb connects the bearer with a higher power.
lines.spoken: This orb connects the bearer with a higher power.

lines.speaker: Kagero
lines.text: Mayhap it will display its true form only to those who open up their hearts to it.
lines.spoken: Mayhap it will display its true form only to those who open up their hearts to it.

lines.speaker: Prishe
lines.text: Delkfutt's Tower...
lines.spoken: [[dˈɛlkfʌts]] Tower...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Ah, you look confused. My companion is intimately connected with the outlying isle that Reisenjima Sanctorium calls home.
lines.spoken: Ah, you look confused. My companion is intimately connected with the outlying isle that [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium calls home.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Her assertion that the orb is authentic is proof enough.
lines.spoken: Her assertion that the orb is authentic is proof enough.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: As such, I am inclined to believe this "Iroha"'s story about being from the future.
lines.spoken: As such, I am inclined to believe this "[[ɪɹˈohə]]"'s story about being from the future.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: I gotta admit, when I saw the little lady floppin' about on that rickety vessel, I wondered if the brine had clogged up that skull o' hers...but then we learned she wasn't the only one from th' future.
lines.spoken: I gotta admit, when I saw the little lady floppin' about on that rickety vessel, I wondered if the brine had clogged up that skull o' hers...but then we learned she wasn't the only one from th' future.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Then there were others?
lines.spoken: Then there were others?

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: None in the Far East bear any ill will toward the priests of Reisenjima Sanctorium...
lines.spoken: None in the Far East bear any ill will toward the priests of [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: And only the purest chosen by the emperor are allowed to alight on the isle housing Reisenjima Sanctorium, for it was created by the gods themselves.
lines.spoken: And only the purest chosen by the emperor are allowed to alight on the isle housing [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]] Sanctorium, for it was created by the gods themselves.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Any who would lift a blade in anger against such souls are unworthy of being called human.
lines.spoken: Any who would lift a blade in anger against such souls are unworthy of being called human.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Then it should not surprise you to learn that our foe isn't human at all.
lines.spoken: Then it should not surprise you to learn that our foe isn't human at all.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Darkness is at his beck and call, and he can create entire worlds devoid of all color.
lines.spoken: Darkness is at his beck and call, and he can create entire worlds devoid of all color.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I see...
lines.spoken: I see...

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Then I must meet with Lady Iroha and find this sinister force that came after her.
lines.spoken: Then I must meet with Lady [[ɪɹˈohə]] and find this sinister force that came after her.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Where should I begin my search?
lines.spoken: Where should I begin my search?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ah, so the orb showed you a vision.
lines.spoken: Ah, so the orb showed you a vision.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: And it implored you to return to Delkfutt's Tower.
lines.spoken: And it implored you to return to [[dˈɛlkfʌts]] Tower.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Perhaps it has something to do with what Kagero said...some relation with the Mothercrystal.
lines.spoken: Perhaps it has something to do with what [[kædʒˈɛɹoʊ]] said...some relation with the Mothercrystal.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Perhaps it has something to do with what Kagero said...some relation with the higher power.
lines.spoken: Perhaps it has something to do with what [[kædʒˈɛɹoʊ]] said...some relation with the higher power.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I must first make for Jeuno to collect what information I can...and handle some unfinished business.
lines.spoken: I must first make for [[dʒjˈuːnoʊ]] to collect what information I can...and handle some unfinished business.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Then we've got all th' clues we need.
lines.spoken: Then we've got all th' clues we need.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: I shall report back with anything I am able to find.
lines.spoken: I shall report back with anything I am able to find.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: <player>, I think it best if you cast your lot with Tenzen.
lines.spoken: adventurer, I think it best if you cast your lot with [[tˈɛnzən]].

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Maybe he'll be able to figure out how to save the future when he gets to meet with Iroha.
lines.spoken: Maybe he'll be able to figure out how to save the future when he gets to meet with [[ɪɹˈohə]].

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: That's what my gut's tellin' me, anyway, and a pirate's intuition is never wrong.
lines.spoken: That's what my gut's tellin' me, anyway, and a pirate's intuition is never wrong.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Oi, <player>! Ya really got a knack fer showin' up when people are thinking about ya.
lines.spoken: Oi, adventurer! Ya really got a knack fer showin' up when people are thinking about ya.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: 'Member how we were talkin' 'bout a new vortex in Misareaux Coast?
lines.spoken: 'Member how we were talkin' 'bout a new vortex in [[mˈɪsɛrˌoʊ]] Coast?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Iroha's been spotted around there every couple o' days.
lines.spoken: [[ˈɪɹoʊhəz]] been spotted around there every couple o' days.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: ...And you didn't know, did ya?
lines.spoken: ...And you didn't know, did ya?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: The two of ya last parted ways o'er in Aht Urhgan, right?
lines.spoken: The two of ya last parted ways o'er in Aht [[ˈʌrhɡən]], right?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Figured she'd've met up with ya once she was feelin' better, but for whatever reason she's decided to strike out on her own.
lines.spoken: Figured she'd've met up with ya once she was feelin' better, but for whatever reason she's decided to strike out on her own.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ya ha!
lines.spoken: Ya ha!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ya musta had a big fallin'-out!
lines.spoken: Ya musta had a big fallin'-out!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Then go crawlin' on yer hands and knees and beg fer her forgiveness!
lines.spoken: Then go crawlin' on yer hands and knees and beg fer her forgiveness!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Bah, it's probably nothin'. Kids her age can be that way.
lines.spoken: Bah, it's probably nothin'. Kids her age can be that way.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: You have impure thoughts about her!
lines.spoken: You have impure thoughts about her!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: You're jealous of her!
lines.spoken: You're jealous of her!

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Well, best for me not ta get in the middle. Now that you know where she's been spotted, ya'd best head there too.
lines.spoken: Well, best for me not ta get in the middle. Now that you know where she's been spotted, ya'd best head there too.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Knowin' Tenzen, he's probably in a tizzy and gone to Misareaux Coast already.
lines.spoken: Knowin' [[tˈɛnzən]], he's probably in a tizzy and gone to [[mˈɪsɛrˌoʊ]] Coast already.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Truth be told, I can't imagine what it would be like ta die once, let alone over and over...
lines.spoken: Truth be told, I can't imagine what it would be like ta die once, let alone over and over...

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Youth is always so brash. Hopefully the three of ya can overcome the trials that are ta come.
lines.spoken: Youth is always so brash. Hopefully the three of ya can overcome the trials that are ta come.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Yar, Iroha's already given me the skinny.
lines.spoken: Yar, [[ˈɪɹoʊhəz]] already given me the skinny.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: So yer off ta meet the ancients, hmm?
lines.spoken: So yer off ta meet the ancients, hmm?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Best place to find whatcha seek would be in the Temple of Uggalepih.
lines.spoken: Best place to find whatcha seek would be in the Temple of [[ˈʌɡeɪlpi]].

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: But don't ya be needin' ta lay anchor in Kazham first?
lines.spoken: But don't ya be needin' ta lay anchor in [[kˈæʒæm]] first?

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Best place ta get in contact with 'em would be over in the Temple of Uggalepih.
lines.spoken: Best place ta get in contact with 'em would be over in the Temple of [[ˈʌɡeɪlpi]].

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ain't but a waddle away.
lines.spoken: Ain't but a waddle away.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Then what I'm 'bout ta tell ya is th' same as before: ya gotta go to the Temple of Uggalepih.
lines.spoken: Then what I'm 'bout ta tell ya is th' same as before: ya gotta go to the Temple of [[ˈʌɡeɪlpi]].

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Ain't too far, and if ye've been there once then it shouldn't be a problem ta make th' trek again.
lines.spoken: Ain't too far, and if ye've been there once then it shouldn't be a problem ta make th' trek again.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lord <player>, perhaps you have some unfinished business to take care of first. We shall scout on ahead.
lines.spoken: Lord adventurer, perhaps you have some unfinished business to take care of first. We shall scout on ahead.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Lady <player>, perhaps you have some unfinished business to take care of first. We shall scout on ahead.
lines.spoken: Lady adventurer, perhaps you have some unfinished business to take care of first. We shall scout on ahead.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I bid you finish your tasks without delay.
lines.spoken: I bid you finish your tasks without delay.

lines.speaker: Tenzen
lines.text: Sir Gilgamesh, I fear we know little and less about this temple of which you speak.
lines.spoken: Sir [[ɡˈɪlɡʌmˌɛʃ]], I fear we know little and less about this temple of which you speak.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: It's a bit ta the east, beyond Yuhtunga Jungle, deep in th' innermost recesses of Yhoator Jungle.
lines.spoken: It's a bit ta the east, beyond Yuhtunga Jungle, deep in th' innermost recesses of [[jˈoʊɐtɔːɹ]] Jungle.

lines.speaker: Gilgamesh
lines.text: Surely you'll want a few of my best men ta go with ya. Wouldn't do havin' ya get lost.
lines.spoken: Surely you'll want a few of my best men ta go with ya. Wouldn't do havin' ya get lost.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: That would be a boon.
lines.spoken: That would be a boon.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, let us rendezvous at the temple.
lines.spoken: Master, let us rendezvous at the temple.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I relish the opportunity to meet with a Kuluu.
lines.spoken: I relish the opportunity to meet with a [[kjˈʊluː]].

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: The only color here is the color of death.
lines.spoken: The only color here is the color of death.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: This empty husk is void of anything that we could call nature.
lines.spoken: This empty husk is void of anything that we could call nature.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: The first thing I noticed about this place is its striking resemblance to the Sanctuary of Zi'Tah, located in northeastern Mindartia.
lines.spoken: The first thing I noticed about this place is its striking resemblance to the Sanctuary of [[zɪɾˈaː]], located in northeastern [[mɪndˈaːɹʃə]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Zi'Tah...yes, I have run across that name several times before.
lines.spoken: [[zɪɾˈaː]]...yes, I have run across that name several times before.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Yes, it was when the master first visited Reisenjima.
lines.spoken: Yes, it was when the master first visited [[ɹˈaɪzəndʒˌɪmə]].

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: He said there was a sanctuary there, much like one in my homeland.
lines.spoken: He said there was a sanctuary there, much like one in my homeland.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: She said there was a sanctuary there, much like one in my homeland.
lines.spoken: She said there was a sanctuary there, much like one in my homeland.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Those chosen by the mothercrystal may enter a holy shrine deep within the Sanctuary to receive the protection of the Dawnmaidens.
lines.spoken: Those chosen by the mothercrystal may enter a holy shrine deep within the Sanctuary to receive the protection of the Dawnmaidens.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I had envisioned it to be more bursting with splendor...
lines.spoken: I had envisioned it to be more bursting with splendor...

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Its layout and features resemble Zi'Tah, of that there can be no doubt. Yet the magic and warmth are gone, like we are in a different world entirely.
lines.spoken: Its layout and features resemble [[zɪɾˈaː]], of that there can be no doubt. Yet the magic and warmth are gone, like we are in a different world entirely.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: ...Or is this the future?
lines.spoken: ...Or is this the future?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I do not believe so.
lines.spoken: I do not believe so.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: If the coming Emptiness is to swallow the world, then I would be more inclined to believe that we are catching a glimpse of what that swallowed world would be like.
lines.spoken: If the coming Emptiness is to swallow the world, then I would be more inclined to believe that we are catching a glimpse of what that swallowed world would be like.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Did you hear that?
lines.spoken: Did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: A...bell? But where...?
lines.spoken: A...bell? But where...?

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: Urk...

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Who goes there?
lines.spoken: Who goes there?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Zeid! Please, stay with us!
lines.spoken: [[zˈaɪd]]! Please, stay with us!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Zeid, Lion! Please, stay with us!
lines.spoken: [[zˈaɪd]], Lion! Please, stay with us!

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Something foul is afoot. The world blurred and I took leave of myself.
lines.spoken: Something foul is afoot. The world blurred and I took leave of myself.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: You were under its thrall.
lines.spoken: You were under its thrall.

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: It gives me chills just thinking about it.
lines.spoken: It gives me chills just thinking about it.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: If the clamoring has ceased, then we may yet find respite.
lines.spoken: If the clamoring has ceased, then we may yet find respite.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, this may be the world we refer to as "Escha."
lines.spoken: Master, this may be the world we refer to as "Escha."

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I still have much to learn, but your words that day will always stay with me:
lines.spoken: I still have much to learn, but your words that day will always stay with me:

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: "When the darkness first came, the Middle Lands were the first to be assaulted. Swaths of land were consumed, leaving a colorless landscape where life once thrived.
lines.spoken: "When the darkness first came, the Middle Lands were the first to be assaulted. Swaths of land were consumed, leaving a colorless landscape where life once thrived.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: "It marked the beginning of the end."
lines.spoken: "It marked the beginning of the end."

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: And that world, you said, was known as Escha.
lines.spoken: And that world, you said, was known as Escha.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Yet the annals say that the Emptiness first started to appear many years hence.
lines.spoken: Yet the annals say that the Emptiness first started to appear many years hence.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: So why now? Why here?
lines.spoken: So why now? Why here?

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: What if...history were being rewritten?
lines.spoken: What if...history were being rewritten?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: It could be that my returning to your time has placed a stick in the wheel of fate.
lines.spoken: It could be that my returning to your time has placed a stick in the wheel of fate.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Has the darkness come with me?
lines.spoken: Has the darkness come with me?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Though this may sound counterintuitive, I fear we must change the future if we are to save the past.
lines.spoken: Though this may sound counterintuitive, I fear we must change the future if we are to save the past.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: You are right. That is rather difficult to wrap my head around.
lines.spoken: You are right. That is rather difficult to wrap my head around.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Iroha, is there no way to purge this "Escha" from our land?
lines.spoken: [[ɪɹˈohə]], is there no way to purge this "Escha" from our land?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Would that I had the answers you seek.
lines.spoken: Would that I had the answers you seek.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Then only one path lies open to us: figure out what we can for ourselves.
lines.spoken: Then only one path lies open to us: figure out what we can for ourselves.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: As if this land were not dangerous enough, now we have that unholy bell to contend with.
lines.spoken: As if this land were not dangerous enough, now we have that unholy bell to contend with.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: A perilous reality at best.
lines.spoken: A perilous reality at best.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Lady Lion!
lines.spoken: Lady Lion!

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: <player>!
lines.spoken: adventurer!

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: And who is this?
lines.spoken: And who is this?

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: So you're the one who's joined us from the future.
lines.spoken: So you're the one who's joined us from the future.

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: I'm not one to put stock in fairy tales, yet here we are in this alternate dimension...so I'm willing to believe your tale.
lines.spoken: I'm not one to put stock in fairy tales, yet here we are in this alternate dimension...so I'm willing to believe your tale.

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: I suppose there are worse outcomes when being sucked up by a vortex.
lines.spoken: I suppose there are worse outcomes when being sucked up by a vortex.

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: And look who saved me.
lines.spoken: And look who saved me.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Don't let your guard down for a second. This may look like the Sanctuary of Zi'Tah, but it is not the one we know.
lines.spoken: Don't let your guard down for a second. This may look like the Sanctuary of [[zɪɾˈaː]], but it is not the one we know.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Are you the one known as Zeid?
lines.spoken: Are you the one known as [[zˈaɪd]]?

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: That is right. And you must be Iroha--Aldo has told me much about you.
lines.spoken: That is right. And you must be Iroha--Aldo has told me much about you.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: I knew I had to investigate as soon as I heard something was amiss.
lines.spoken: I knew I had to investigate as soon as I heard something was amiss.

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: Maybe we should return to the mothercrystal first.
lines.spoken: Maybe we should return to the mothercrystal first.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Have you any insight, Lion?
lines.spoken: Have you any insight, Lion?

lines.speaker: Lion
lines.text: Nothing but my gut. I can feel her...calling out to me.
lines.spoken: Nothing but my gut. I can feel her...calling out to me.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Lion? Wait!
lines.spoken: Lion? Wait!

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: I know not what role she has to play, but her intimate bond with the future is beyond denial.
lines.spoken: I know not what role she has to play, but her intimate bond with the future is beyond denial.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, perhaps it would be best if we follow her.
lines.spoken: Master, perhaps it would be best if we follow her.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Where are we?
lines.spoken: Where are we?

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah...but not the one we know.
lines.spoken: The Sanctuary of [[zɪɾˈaː]]...but not the one we know.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Master, perhaps Lion could provide us with the guidance that we so desperately require.
lines.spoken: Master, perhaps Lion could provide us with the guidance that we so desperately require.

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Lion?
lines.spoken: Lion?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: My understanding is that none resonate with the mothercrystal more strongly than she.
lines.spoken: My understanding is that none resonate with the mothercrystal more strongly than she.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Your role in protecting our future is vital, Master, but Lion is of equal importance.
lines.spoken: Your role in protecting our future is vital, Master, but Lion is of equal importance.

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: She is with the crystal now, is she not?
lines.spoken: She is with the crystal now, is she not?

lines.speaker: Iroha
lines.text: Then we must go. Hurry!
lines.spoken: Then we must go. Hurry!

lines.speaker: Zeid
lines.text: Iroha? Wait!
lines.spoken: [[ɪɹˈohə]]? Wait!
